title: Real-Life: Museum tickets
situation: You want to visit the museum's special dinosaur exhibition with your two children, aged 8 and 13. You want to spend as little as possible. You hear the following message.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Buy a family pass online.
Buy individual tickets at the entrance on a weekend.
Buy only general admission tickets.
Visit on a Wednesday and buy exhibition tickets.
questions.explanation: 水曜日なら入館は無料なので、特別展チケット(大人10ドル+子ども5ドル×2=20ドル)だけで済み最も安い。ファミリーパスは40ドル。

title: Real-Life: Lost luggage
situation: Your suitcase did not arrive at the airport. You are staying at a hotel downtown and are leaving the city in two days. You hear the following explanation at the baggage service counter.

questions.question: What should you do first?
choices: Go to Chicago to get your bag.
Fill out a form with your contact details.
Buy a new suitcase.
Wait at the airport until tomorrow.
questions.explanation: 最初にすべきことは、帰る前に連絡先を用紙に記入すること。荷物の受け取りや買い物はその後。

title: Real-Life: Apartment repairs
situation: Water is leaking from the ceiling of your bathroom. You work from 9 a.m. to 6 p.m. on weekdays. You call your building manager and hear the following message.

questions.question: What should you do first?
choices: Fill out a form on the website.
Call the office again tomorrow at nine.
Turn off the valve under the kitchen sink.
Turn off the valve in the bathroom.
questions.explanation: 水漏れは緊急なので、まず台所の流し台の下の元栓を閉める(その後緊急ダイヤルに電話)。元栓は浴室ではなく台所にある。

title: Real-Life: Package delivery
situation: You missed a delivery while you were at work. You leave home at 8 a.m. and return at 7 p.m. on weekdays. You are free this Saturday. You hear the following message.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Ask for redelivery tomorrow morning.
Go to the service center on Saturday afternoon.
Wait for the package to be delivered on Saturday.
Ask for redelivery tomorrow evening.
questions.explanation: 帰宅は午後7時なので、明日の午後6時から9時の再配達で受け取れる。土曜日のセンターは正午までなので午後では間に合わない。

title: Real-Life: Hotel check-out
situation: You are staying at a hotel. Your flight leaves at 7 p.m. today, and you want to go sightseeing until 3 p.m. You do not want to carry your luggage. You hear the following information from the front desk.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Pay for late check-out until two p.m.
Take your luggage with you while sightseeing.
Check out by eleven and leave your bags at the front desk.
Take the shuttle bus at five p.m.
questions.explanation: 11時にチェックアウトして荷物をフロントに無料で預ければ、3時まで手ぶらで観光でき、4時のバス(フライトの3時間前)に間に合う。

title: Real-Life: Smartphone repair
situation: The screen of your smartphone is cracked. You bought the phone 18 months ago. You need to use a phone for work every day. You hear the following explanation at a repair shop.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Use the express repair service.
Ask the manufacturer to repair it for free.
Have the phone repaired and borrow a replacement.
Wait three to five days without a phone.
questions.explanation: 特急サービスは対象外の機種で、保証も切れている。毎日電話が必要なので、通常修理を頼み代わりの電話を借りるのが正しい。

title: Real-Life: Office move
situation: You are an employee at a company that is moving to a new office. You have a lot of documents in your desk that you need to keep. You hear the following announcement from your manager.

questions.question: What should you do with the documents you need?
choices: Put them in the blue bins.
Pack them in boxes labeled with your name and desk number.
Give them to the IT team.
Leave them in your desk until the move.
questions.explanation: 持っていく書類は箱に詰め、名前と新しい机の番号を書く。青い箱は不要書類用で、机に残すと処分される。

title: Real-Life: Rental car return
situation: You rented a car and need to return it. Your flight leaves at 6 a.m. tomorrow, and the gas tank is half full. You hear the following explanation from the rental company.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Return the car at the counter at seven a.m.
Return the car without refueling.
Fill the tank and use the after-hours return area.
Leave the key at the counter tonight at eleven.
questions.explanation: 6時発の便ではカウンターが開く7時を待てない。ガソリンを満タンにして時間外返却エリアに停め、鍵を返却ボックスに入れる。

title: Real-Life: Moving trash
situation: You are moving out of your apartment this weekend. You have an old sofa and a broken microwave oven to throw away. You call the city office and hear the following message.

questions.question: What should you do with the sofa?
choices: Take it to the recycling center this weekend.
Book a pickup for next week.
Put it out with the regular trash.
Take it to an electronics store.
questions.explanation: 今週末に引っ越すので1週間前予約の回収には間に合わない。週末なら予約なしでリサイクルセンターに持ち込める。

title: Real-Life: Internet problem
situation: Your home internet has stopped working. The lights on your router are blinking red. You call the internet provider and hear the following message.

questions.question: You live in the Northfield area. What should you do?
choices: Wait until six p.m. for service to return.
Restart your router and then book a technician if needed.
Check your computer's settings.
Call back after the outage ends.
questions.explanation: 障害地域ではないので、まずルーターを再起動する。ランプが赤く点滅したままならケーブルの問題なので技術者を予約する。

title: Real-Life: Bank card
situation: You lost your bank card yesterday. You think you dropped it on the street. You call your bank and hear the following message.

questions.question: What should you do first?
choices: Order a new card online.
Visit a branch for a temporary card.
Report to the fraud department.
Press one to stop the card.
questions.explanation: まず1を押してカードを停止する。新カードの注文や仮カードの発行は停止の後。

title: Real-Life: Hiking trail
situation: You are planning a hike with your friends tomorrow. You want a trail that takes less than four hours and has a view of the lake. You hear the following information at a visitor center.

questions.question: Which trail should you take?
choices: The Waterfall Trail.
The Ridge Trail.
The Forest Trail.
The Summit Trail.
questions.explanation: リッジ・トレイルは迂回で約4時間半になる。4時間未満で湖が見えるのは3時間半で湖畔を通るウォーターフォール・トレイル。

title: Real-Life: Office printer
situation: You need to print 200 color copies of a brochure by noon today. It is now 9 a.m. You call the office services department and hear the following message.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Contact Mark in the design department.
Submit your file through the print portal.
Use the printer on your own floor.
Print the brochure in black and white.
questions.explanation: 大量のカラー印刷を正午までに必要としている。印刷ポータル経由のカラーは1営業日かかるので、マークに連絡して5階の高速カラープリンターの使用許可を得る。

title: Real-Life: Museum tour
situation: You are visiting a museum with your eight-year-old son. You want to join a guided tour that he will enjoy. You hear the following announcement.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Go to the dinosaur hall at eleven.
Join the pottery tour at eleven.
Register for the photography tour by 2:15.
Register at the information desk by 12:45.
questions.explanation: 8歳の息子に合うのは6〜12歳向けの1時の恐竜ファミリーツアー。開始15分前までに案内所で申し込む必要があるので12時45分までに登録する。

title: Real-Life: Airport check-in
situation: Your flight leaves at 11:40 a.m. You have one large suitcase to check. You arrive at the airport at 10:50 a.m. and hear the following announcement.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Talk to a staff member in a yellow vest.
Check in using the mobile app.
Go directly to the security area.
Use an automatic check-in machine.
questions.explanation: 荷物を預ける必要があり、11時40分発の便の手荷物受付は40分前の11時に締め切られる。到着は10時50分で時間が迫っているので、優先レーンに案内してくれる黄色いベストの係員に話しかける。アプリと保安検査場直行は預け荷物のない人向け。

title: Real-Life: Dental appointment
situation: You have a toothache and want to see a dentist today. You finish work at 5:30 p.m. You call a dental clinic and hear the following message.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Press 1.
Press 3.
Visit the clinic's website.
Press 2.
questions.explanation: 今日中に診てもらいたいが、仕事が終わるのは5時30分で、午後2時までには行けない。夜9時まで緊急診療をしている提携先のリバーサイド歯科につないでもらうため2を押す。

title: Real-Life: Language school placement
situation: You want to join an evening Spanish class at a language school. You studied Spanish for two years at university. A staff member tells you the following.

questions.question: What should you do first?
choices: Sign up for the Beginner class.
Take the online test.
Pay for a course at the front desk.
Contact a teacher directly.
questions.explanation: 大学で2年間スペイン語を学んでいるので、クラス分けテストを受ける必要がある。レベルが分かるまでは料金を払わないよう言われているので、まずオンラインのテストを受ける。初級クラスへの直接申し込みは未経験者向け。

title: Real-Life: Laptop repair
situation: Your laptop screen has stopped working. You bought the laptop 18 months ago and paid for the extended warranty. You call the manufacturer and hear the following message.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Take the laptop to an authorized store.
Pay for a repair at a service center.
Fill out a form on the website.
Buy a new extended warranty.
questions.explanation: 購入から18か月なので1年の標準保証は切れているが、3年の延長保証に入っている。延長保証の客は、ウェブサイトの修理フォームに記入して自宅からの無料引き取りを依頼できる。販売店への持ち込みは標準保証期間内の人向け。

title: Real-Life: Theater tickets
situation: You want to buy two tickets for a play this Saturday. You and your friend both want to sit together, and you want to spend no more than $60 per ticket. You call the theater and hear the following message.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Buy tickets on the theater's website.
Go to the box office after it opens.
Reserve two orchestra seats.
Wait for tickets for a different day.
questions.explanation: 隣り合わせで1枚60ドル以下が条件。1階席は85ドルで1席ずつしかない。2階のペア席は55ドルで条件に合うが、窓口で直接買う必要があるので、開いた後に窓口へ行く。オンライン販売は終了している。

title: Real-Life: Large trash collection
situation: You are moving out of your apartment next week and need to get rid of an old sofa. You call the city office and hear the following information.

questions.question: What should you do first?
choices: Buy a sticker at a convenience store.
Put the sofa outside on Wednesday.
Take the sofa back to a store.
Apply online for a collection date.
questions.explanation: 大型品を処分するには、まず処分シールを買う必要があると説明している。収集日の申し込みはその後。店への返却は冷蔵庫とテレビの場合。

title: Real-Life: Fitness club trial
situation: You want to try a yoga class at a fitness club before joining. You are free only on weekday evenings. A staff member tells you the following.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Buy a one-week pass.
Book a free trial class on Saturday.
Join the club immediately.
Try a different program instead.
questions.explanation: 平日の夜しか空いていない。ヨガの無料体験は土曜の午前のみなので参加できない。平日夜のヨガを試すには、15ドルの1週間パスを買うのがよい。入会すれば料金も差し引かれる。

title: Real-Life: Photo printing
situation: You need 50 photo prints for an event tomorrow afternoon. The photos are on your smartphone. You call a photo shop and hear the following.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Order through the smartphone app.
Use a self-service machine.
Ask a staff member at the store counter.
Call the main factory.
questions.explanation: 明日の午後までに50枚必要。アプリは3〜5日かかり間に合わない。セルフサービス機は1回30枚まで。カウンターの係員なら当日中に200枚まで印刷できる。

title: Real-Life: Train pass refund
situation: You bought a three-month train pass two weeks ago, but your company is transferring you to another city next week. You want to get as much money back as possible. You go to the station and a staff member tells you the following.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Use an automatic ticket machine.
Wait until your pass expires.
Ask for the refund in cash.
Bring a letter from your company to a ticket office.
questions.explanation: 転勤で引っ越すので、勤務先からの書類を持っていけば手数料5ドルが免除され、払い戻し額が最も大きくなる。手続きは切符売り場で、自動券売機ではできない。

title: Real-Life: Museum group visit
situation: You are planning a museum visit for a group of 15 students next month. You want a guided tour in English. You call the museum and hear the following.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Press 1 for more information.
Arrive at the museum by 11 a.m.
Call the museum again on a weekday afternoon.
Visit the museum without a reservation.
questions.explanation: 英語のガイドツアーは教育部を通じて2週間前までに予約が必要で、教育部へは平日の午後1時から5時の間にかけ直す必要がある。予約不要なのは日本語のツアー。

title: Real-Life: Moving internet service
situation: You are moving to a new apartment on May 20 and want to keep using the same internet company. You work from home, so you need internet on the day you move. Today is May 15. You call the company and hear the following.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Wait for a technician to install the service.
Cancel the service and choose a new company.
Call again after you move.
Request a portable router right away.
questions.explanation: 今日は5月15日で、引っ越しは5月20日。通常の移転は約14日かかり間に合わない。携帯型ルーターは必要な日の3日前までに頼む必要があるので、すぐに依頼すれば引っ越し当日から使える。

title: Real-Life: Swimming lesson cancellation
situation: Your seven-year-old son has a swimming lesson at Riverside Sports Center on Saturday morning. You call the center and hear the following recorded message.

questions.question: What should you do if you want your son to make up the missed lesson?
choices: Ask for a refund at the front desk on the first floor.
Take your son to the main pool on Saturday afternoon.
Bring your son and your membership card to the small pool on Sunday morning.
Wait until next Saturday and attend the regular lesson.
questions.explanation: 土曜のレッスンは中止で、振替は日曜午前10時に小プールで行われる。振替には会員カードが必要。返金は振替を希望しない場合の手続きである。メインプールは土曜に閉鎖されているので、土曜午後に連れて行ってもレッスンは受けられない。来週土曜の通常レッスンは欠席分の振替にはならない。

title: Real-Life: Residence certificate deadline
situation: You need an English residence certificate for a visa application. The application must be submitted by Friday. Today is Tuesday, and you work until 6 p.m. on weekdays. You call Westbridge City Hall and hear the following recorded message.

questions.question: What is the best way to get the certificate in time?
choices: Request it online and wait for it to be mailed.
Visit the counter on Saturday morning.
Visit the counter on Wednesday evening after work.
Visit the counter on Tuesday evening after work.
questions.explanation: 査証の申請は金曜日までに必要。火曜日の窓口は午後5時に閉まるので、仕事が終わる6時では間に合わない。水曜日は7時まで開いているので、仕事帰りに行ける。郵送は約5営業日かかり、金曜に間に合わない。土曜の窓口は金曜の締め切りより後になる。

title: Real-Life: Campsite reservation change
situation: You booked a two-night stay at Pine Hollow Campground for this weekend. Your family is arriving on Friday at 3 p.m. It is now Thursday at 4 p.m., and you have just received the following message. Your family still wants to camp at Pine Hollow, but they can come only next weekend.

questions.question: What should you do to keep the campsite without paying a fee?
choices: Change the dates to next weekend before six p.m. today.
Cancel the booking and receive a full refund.
Change the dates to next weekend after six p.m. today.
Keep this weekend's booking and switch to a cabin.
questions.explanation: 家族は来週末しか来られず、この週末は使えない。日程変更は本日18時までなら無料(空きがある場合)で、現在は木曜16時なので間に合う。18時以降は20%の手数料がかかる。全額返金のキャンセルは到着の48時間前までで、金曜15時到着なので水曜15時が期限だったため、既に過ぎている。この週末のまま小屋に変えても、来られない日程なので意味がない。

title: Real-Life: Dog boarding pick-up
situation: You left your dog at Happy Paws Pet Hotel while you were on a business trip. You are at home now and want the staff to bring your dog home. You call the pet hotel and hear the following recorded message.

questions.question: What should you do to have your dog delivered to your home?
choices: Bring your receipt to the front desk before 6 p.m.
Pick up your dog at the front desk after 6 p.m.
Ask the staff to bring your dog home today.
Book the delivery service at least one day in advance.
questions.explanation: 自宅への配達は、少なくとも1日前に予約するのが条件。受付での引き取りは午後6時までで、領収書を持って行くが、これは配達ではない。午後6時以降は受付が閉まっている。当日の依頼は1日前の予約という条件に合わないので頼めない。

title: Real-Life: Lost parking ticket
situation: You drove to Central Plaza and parked in the underground garage. Earlier today you bought a sweater for 4,000 yen at a shop in the plaza. You have the receipt in your bag, but you cannot find your parking ticket. At the exit gate, you hear the following message from the intercom.

questions.question: How much will you have to pay to leave the garage?
questions.explanation: 駐車券をなくすと最大料金の2,000円。本日付で3,000円以上の買い物の領収書があれば1,000円割引される。4,000円のセーターなので条件を満たし、2,000円から1,000円を引いて1,000円を払う。2,000円は割引を使わない場合の料金。

title: Real-Life: Race bib collection
situation: You entered the Lakeside Half Marathon, but you will be on a business trip on Saturday. Your friend Mika has agreed to collect your bib, but she has already agreed to collect bibs for two other runners. You will return home on Sunday at 6 a.m., and the race starts at 8 a.m. You call the event office and hear the following recorded message.

questions.question: What should you do to get your bib?
choices: Ask Mika to collect the bib on Saturday.
Collect the bib at the start area on race morning before 7 a.m.
Collect the bib at the Expo Hall on Sunday at 9 a.m.
Collect the bib at the start area on Saturday afternoon.
questions.explanation: 友人は既に2人分の代理を引き受けているため、もう代理人にはなれない。土曜に受け取れないと、土曜午後5時以降は当日朝にスタート会場で配られる。日曜6時に帰宅しても、スタート会場の受け取りは7時まで間に合う。エキスポ会場は土曜だけで、日曜には開いていない。スタート会場で配るのは当日朝だけなので、土曜午後に受け取ることはできない。

title: Real-Life: Sofa delivery
situation: You ordered a sofa that will be delivered on Thursday between 8 a.m. and noon. You work from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. on Thursday, so you will be away from home all day. You live in an apartment building with a concierge desk. You call Oakwood Furniture and hear the following recorded message.

questions.question: What should you do so that the sofa is delivered without any fee?
choices: Give the building concierge written permission in advance.
Call the company on Thursday morning to change the delivery.
Call the company the day before to change the date.
Wait at home until the driver calls thirty minutes before.
questions.explanation: 木曜は一日中不在なので、在宅しなくても受け取れる方法が必要。管理人に預けるには事前の書面での許可が必要で、手数料もかからない。配達当日の変更は3,000円かかる。前日の変更は無料の条件(2日前まで)を満たさない。在宅で待つのは不在の日には不可能。

title: Real-Life: Pharmacy pickup
situation: You had a prescription filled at a hospital pharmacy yesterday, but you have not picked it up yet. You call the pharmacy and hear the following recorded message.

questions.question: How should you get your medicine today?
choices: Ask your insurance company to change the medicine.
Visit the hospital's emergency room for a checkup.
Mail your identification card to the hospital.
Collect your medicine at the first-floor pharmacy window.
questions.explanation: 「Please come to the pharmacy window on the first floor before six p.m. today.」より、今日の午後6時までに1階の薬局の窓口で薬を受け取る。ほかの選択肢は本文に出てこない内容。

title: Real-Life: School trip form
situation: You are the parent of a second-grade student at Maple Elementary School. You hear the following recorded message from the school.

questions.question: Which step is needed for your child to join the trip?
choices: Tell the teacher at the aquarium on Tuesday morning.
Hand in the signed permission form by Monday afternoon.
Pay the trip fee at the school office on Friday.
Ask the library teacher to watch your child.
questions.explanation: 「Without a signed form, your child cannot join the trip.」「Signed forms must be returned to the school office by Monday afternoon.」より、署名入りの許可書を月曜の午後までに学校の事務室へ出す。ほかの選択肢は、本文に費用の話がない、または時期や場所が合わない。

title: Real-Life: Bus route detour
situation: You live on Oak Street and usually take the number 12 bus to work on weekdays. You call the bus company and hear the following recorded message.

questions.question: How can you get to work during the repairs?
choices: Walk two blocks east to Elm Avenue and board the number nine bus.
Wait at Oak Street for the number 12 bus.
Take a taxi across the bridge on Harbor Road.
Call the bus company to request a new route.
questions.explanation: 「This bus stops on Elm Avenue, about two blocks east of the closed stop.」より、オーク通りから2区画東のエルム通りまで歩き、9番のバスに乗る。12番は工事中は橋を渡らず、オーク通りの停留所も閉鎖されている。

title: Real-Life: Warning light
situation: Tonight the red oil warning light came on while you were driving your car. You need the car for a job interview tomorrow morning. You call Eastside Auto Service and hear the following recorded message.

questions.question: What should you do tonight?
choices: Pull over, switch off the engine, and phone the 24-hour line for a free pickup.
Drive to the service center and wait for a walk-in check.
Book an appointment online for Monday morning.
Keep driving carefully until you reach home.
questions.explanation: 「If the red oil pressure light is on, stop the engine right away and do not drive」と「only if you call the emergency line first」をつなぐ。赤い警告灯なので運転せず、先に緊急用の電話にかけて無料のけん引を頼む。月曜の予約は黄色い警告灯の場合の手順なので、今夜の対応としては誤り。

title: Real-Life: Pottery workshop change
situation: You signed up for a pottery workshop at Hillside Community Center. You hear the following message on the phone, and you are not sure when and where the workshop is now.

questions.question: When and where should you go to attend the workshop?
choices: Go to Room 3 on Thursday evening.
Head to the ground-floor studio on Saturday morning.
Go to Room 7 on Friday evening with your own apron.
Go to the ground-floor studio on Saturday afternoon.
questions.explanation: 最後の案内は「The workshop will take place on Saturday morning in the ground-floor studio」。木曜の3号室は水漏れで、金曜の7号室は窯の修理で使えないと訂正されている。土曜の午後は誤りで、場所は同じ1階のスタジオでも時間が違う。

title: Real-Life: Planned power outage
situation: You live in an apartment in Northern City. You receive the following recorded message from the electric company.

questions.question: Which task should you finish before Sunday morning?
choices: Fully charge your phones and other devices.
Move your bicycle to the garage on Saturday.
Contact the city council about the road repairs.
Send a payment to the power company by Friday.
questions.explanation: 「Please charge your phones and other devices before Sunday morning」より、日曜の朝までにスマートフォンなどを充電しておく。ほかの選択肢は本文に出てこない内容。

title: Real-Life: Dog vaccination reminder
situation: You have a dog named Max, and its rabies vaccination is due this month. You call the animal clinic and hear the following recorded message.

questions.question: How can you keep your dog's vaccination on schedule?
choices: Walk your dog into the clinic on Saturday afternoon.
Email the vaccination record to the city council.
Phone the clinic to schedule a time before the month is over.
Give your dog the vaccination at home this weekend.
questions.explanation: 「your dog's rabies vaccination is due by the end of this month」「please call us to book a time」より、今月末までに電話で予約を取る。土曜の午後は休診で、予約なしの接種もできない。

title: Real-Life: Wrong bookshelf delivered
situation: You ordered a tall bookshelf from Oakwood Furniture, but the one delivered yesterday is the standard size and does not fit your room. You call the store and hear the following conversation with the clerk.

questions.question: What should the man do to get the tall model at no charge?
choices: Stay home on Thursday and wait for the truck.
Pay the extra fee for a collection on another day.
Take the old shelf and the receipt to the downtown branch by Friday.
Ask the store to refund the full price of the bookshelf.
questions.explanation: 「the downtown branch can exchange it at no charge if the old shelf is brought in by Friday」「please bring the receipt with the shelf」より、金曜までに古い棚とレシートを持ち込む。男性は木曜に仕事で家にいられないので、無料の木曜の引き取りは使えない。

title: Real-Life: Essay submission during maintenance
situation: You are a university student. Your essay is due on Sunday, and it is now Saturday night. The file is large, and you have not finished it. You hear the following message from the university's IT department.

questions.question: How should you submit your essay on time?
choices: Submit the essay through the student portal on Sunday morning.
Request a one-day extension through the portal right now.
Upload the essay to the library's cloud drive on Monday morning.
Shrink the file below the size limit and email it to your professor by midnight.
questions.explanation: 「professors will accept them by email until midnight」と「please compress large files before you send them」をつなぐ。土曜の夜なので延長は申請できず、日曜の午前はポータルが停止している。大きいファイルは圧縮してメールで提出する。

title: Real-Life: Boat tour departure change
situation: You booked a boat tour for this Saturday afternoon. You hear the following message from the tour company on your voicemail.

questions.question: Where should you go to join the boat tour on Saturday?
choices: Go to Pier 2 at one p.m. for the first boat.
Head to the small marina beside the lighthouse for the one-thirty departure.
Go to Pier 5 and then take the bus from the train station.
Wait at the train station for a boat to pick you up.
questions.explanation: 最後の案内は「The final departure point is the small marina next to the lighthouse, and boats will leave at one thirty p.m.」。2番埠頭は修理、5番埠頭は工事で使えないと訂正されている。駅のバスは駐車場が混むときの移動手段で、駅で船を待つのは誤り。

title: Real-Life: Fire drill at work
situation: You work in an office building. You hear the following announcement over the speaker on Tuesday morning.

questions.question: What should you do when you hear the alarm?
choices: Call the building manager from your desk.
Finish the report on your computer first.
Gather in the cafeteria on the second floor.
Go down the nearest staircase right away.
questions.explanation: 「When you hear the alarm, leave your desk immediately and walk to the nearest staircase.」より、警報が鳴ったら机をすぐ離れ、いちばん近い階段で降りる。エレベーターは使わない。ほかの選択肢は本文に出てこない内容。

title: Real-Life: Restaurant booking change
situation: You booked a table for four at a restaurant for this Saturday. Now one friend cannot come, so you call the restaurant to change the booking. You hear the following conversation.

questions.question: How can you keep the new booking?
choices: Bring a fourth friend to the table at seven.
Phone the restaurant to confirm the change by Friday noon.
Pay the full price of the meal in advance.
Keep the booking at seven and cancel on Saturday.
questions.explanation: 「please confirm the change by phone before Friday noon, or the booking will be released」より、金曜の正午までに電話で変更を確認する。7時のままにする、友人を追加する、前払いするという内容は本文にない。

title: Real-Life: Daycare pickup change
situation: Your son attends Sunnyside Daycare. You are on your way to work when you hear the following voicemail from the daycare.

questions.question: Where and when should you collect your son today?
choices: Collect your son at the Maple Street side entrance after five forty-five.
Use the front entrance at five thirty p.m.
Park in the daycare lot and wait inside.
Pick him up at the Maple Street side door at five thirty.
questions.explanation: 「Children will be dismissed at the side door on Maple Street」と「please come after five forty-five」をつなぐ。正門は閉まっていて、先生が忙しい5時30分は避ける。駐車場は修理中なので、駐車して中で待つのは誤り。

title: Real-Life: Driver's license renewal
situation: You are sixty-eight years old. Your driver's license expires in six days, and you have not renewed it yet. You call the licensing office and hear the following recorded message.

questions.question: How should you renew your license?
choices: Visit a licensing office in person before it expires.
Mail the renewal form and a copy of the license today.
Take an eye test at home and send the result by mail.
Renew online using the renewal form on the website.
questions.explanation: 「Renewal forms must be postmarked at least ten days before the expiration date.」と「expires in six days」をつなぐ。郵送の期限に間に合わないので、有効期限の前に窓口へ行く。視力検査は75歳以上の人の条件で、この人は対象外。

title: Real-Life: Stadium gate update
situation: You have a lower-section ticket for tonight's baseball game at Northfield Stadium. On the way there, you receive the following urgent message on your phone.

questions.question: Which gate should you use with your lower-section ticket?
choices: Use the north gate, as announced first.
Proceed through the east gate, which lower-section fans may also use.
Wait at the west gate until it reopens at four thirty.
Head to the main gate near the parking lot.
questions.explanation: 最後の案内は「Lower-section fans may also enter through the east gate」。北ゲートは機材で使えず、西ゲートは安全点検で閉鎖され、今夜は再開しないと訂正されている。午後4時30分の西ゲートを待つのは誤り。

title: Real-Life: Zoo talk change
situation: You are visiting Westbridge Zoo today and want to see the penguins. You hear the following announcement at the zoo entrance.

questions.question: Where should you go at three p.m. today?
choices: Head to the North Pond for the penguin talk.
Ride the train around the zoo at noon.
Visit the gift shop before closing time.
Wait at the main gate until the zoo closes.
questions.explanation: 「a short talk about penguins will take place at three p.m. at the North Pond」より、午後3時に北の池で行われるペンギンの話を聞きに行く。ほかの選択肢は本文に出てこない内容。

title: Real-Life: Mobile plan cancellation
situation: You want to cancel your mobile phone plan because you are moving abroad next week. You cannot visit a store, so you call the phone company and hear the following recorded message.

questions.question: How can you cancel the plan from abroad?
choices: Call the cancellation agent and wait on the line.
Send your SIM card to the company by mail.
Use the online cancellation form before the month ends.
Visit a store after the next month begins.
questions.explanation: 「use the cancellation form on our website」と「If you cancel before the end of the month, you will not be charged for the next month」より、月末までにウェブサイトの解約フォームから解約する。電話での解約は受け付けていないので、電話で待つのは誤り。

title: Real-Life: Car insurance claim
situation: You had a small accident in a parking lot yesterday. Your car bumper is cracked, and you need to file a claim with your insurance company. You hear the following conversation with the claims agent.

questions.question: What should the man do to get the claim processed in time?
choices: Upload the photos through the app on his phone.
Visit the nearest office and hand in the photos.
Post the printed pictures to the claims department by Friday.
Send the photos by email tomorrow morning.
questions.explanation: 「you can mail the printed photos to our claims center」と「if they arrive after Friday, the claim may be delayed」をつなぐ。アプリは使えず、営業所は遠く、メールは使えないので、印刷した写真を金曜までに郵送する。

title: Real-Life: Job center interview
situation: You are a job seeker with an interview at Crown Logistics on Tuesday, but you are also registered for a training session at the job center at the same time. You call the job center and hear the following conversation.

questions.question: Which step will let you attend the interview on Tuesday?
choices: Attend the training session at the job center on Tuesday.
Go to Crown Logistics after the training is finished.
Retake the safety course before the interview.
Provide proof of your completed safety course to the center by Monday.
questions.explanation: 「people who have already completed the safety course are exempt」と「You must give us a copy of your certificate by Monday」をつなぐ。修了証の写しを月曜までに出せば研修は免除され、面接に行ける。火曜の研修に出る、講習を受け直すという内容は誤り。

title: Real-Life: Elevator repair and moving
situation: You need to move a heavy piano out of your apartment this week. You hear the following announcement from the building manager.

questions.question: How should you move your piano?
choices: Use the freight elevator on Thursday afternoon.
Arrange to use the rear ramp on Friday morning.
Move the piano in a passenger elevator this week.
Leave the piano in the hallway until the freight elevator is fixed.
questions.explanation: 最後の案内は「the rear ramp can be used on Friday morning」。木曜の荷物用エレベーターは故障で使えず、客用エレベーターはピアノを運ぶのに使えないと訂正されている。水曜の夕方までに受付で予約する必要がある。

title: Real-Life: Holiday cake pickup
situation: You ordered a holiday cake from Sweet Crumb Bakery. You have not picked it up yet, so you hear the following recorded message when you call the shop.

questions.question: How can you keep your cake from being sold?
choices: Pay the full price on the phone tomorrow.
Order a different cake for the next holiday.
Ask the shop to deliver the cake to your house.
Claim your cake before six p.m. today.
questions.explanation: 「We can keep it at the counter until six p.m. today.」より、今日の午後6時までに店で受け取る。ほかの選択肢は本文に出てこない内容か、本文と食い違う内容。

title: Real-Life: International parcel
situation: You want to send a sweater to your cousin in Canada. At the post office counter, you hear the following conversation with the clerk.

questions.question: How can you make sure the box arrives next week?
choices: Send the box by standard mail, which takes about three weeks.
Choose the express service and attach a customs form to the box.
Mail the sweater without a form, using the standard service.
Ask the clerk to hold the box until next month.
questions.explanation: 「For the speed you need, express service is faster, but it requires a customs form.」より、速達を選び、税関申告書を箱に付ける。標準郵便は約3週間かかるので来週には間に合わない。申告書なしの郵送は受け付けられない。

title: Real-Life: Ski lift closure
situation: You are skiing with your friend at a mountain resort. You are now at the summit, and you want to get back to the base area. You hear the following announcement on the mountain radio.

questions.question: How can you get back to the base area?
choices: Ride the cable car from the summit to the base.
Ski down the Eagle run to the base area.
Take the Summit Express, which is now open again.
Ride the gondola from the base area back to the top.
questions.explanation: 「Skiers at the top are asked to use the Blue Ridge gondola instead」より、山頂からブルーリッジのゴンドラ(ロープウェイ)で麓へ戻る。イーグル・コースは氷のため閉鎖、サミット・エクスプレスは再開時間が未定で使えない。

title: Real-Life: Tax filing deadline
situation: You are a freelance designer. All of your records for this year are on paper, and you have not finished your tax return. It is Thursday, and you call the tax office. You hear the following recorded message.

questions.question: Which option should you choose before Friday?
choices: Telephone the office to request more time before Friday.
Hand in the paper forms at the office on Friday evening.
Attach scanned receipts to the online form before midnight.
Request an extension through the website tonight.
questions.explanation: 「Filers who keep their records only on paper cannot file online.」と「they must request an extension by phone before Friday」をつなぐ。紙の記録しかないので、オンラインは使えず、金曜より前に電話で延長を申し込む。金曜の夕方は閉庁後で、延長はウェブサイトでは受け付けない。

title: Real-Life: Loan meeting schedule
situation: You applied for a home loan at Eastbank. The loan officer calls you about your appointment, and you hear the following conversation.

questions.question: What should you do to keep the Thursday appointment?
choices: Visit the Lake Street branch on Monday at ten.
Provide this year's income statement to the bank by Wednesday.
Meet the manager on Tuesday at two in the afternoon.
Send last year's income statement to the bank tonight.
questions.explanation: 最後の案内は「the income statement by Wednesday」と「this year's statement」。月曜の10時は最初の時間、火曜の2時は取りやめで、去年の書類は使えないと訂正されている。

title: Real-Life: Tap water boil notice
situation: You live on Pine Street. You hear the following recorded message from the water company.

questions.question: What should you do before drinking tap water?
choices: Heat tap water to a boil before drinking it.
Bring your own bottle to the water company office.
Use the tap water only for washing the floor.
Wait until the notice is lifted by text message.
questions.explanation: 「please boil all water before you drink it」より、水道水は沸騰させてから飲む。水道会社の事務所で水を受け取る、床だけに使う、通知が解除されるのを待つという内容は本文にない。

title: Real-Life: Festival shuttle bus
situation: You are going to a summer music festival by car, but the parking lot at the park may be full. You hear the following announcement on the radio.

questions.question: How should you get to the festival if you plan to drive?
choices: Drive to Green Park and park in the main lot.
Pay ten dollars to park at the main gate.
Leave your car at Riverside Station and ride the free shuttle bus.
Take the shuttle from Green Park every fifteen minutes.
questions.explanation: 「park your car at the Riverside Station car park and take the free shuttle bus」より、車はリバーサイド駅の駐車場に停め、無料のシャトルバスに乗る。グリーンパークの駐車場は満車で、正門の駐車場は本文にない。

title: Real-Life: Brake repair estimate
situation: Your car makes a grinding noise when you brake. You are taking it to a garage, and you are planning a trip to the coast tomorrow. You hear the following conversation with the mechanic.

questions.question: What should the man do to drive to the coast safely tomorrow?
choices: Skip the brake work and drive carefully to the coast.
Ask for the rear discs to be replaced today.
Get the worn front brake pads changed today.
Drive to the coast and have the brakes checked there.
questions.explanation: 「The front brake pads are worn out, so they need to be replaced today.」より、前のブレーキパッドを今日交換する。後ろのディスクは取り寄せになり今日はできず、ブレーキの作業を飛ばすのは誤り。

title: Real-Life: Blood test results
situation: You had a blood test at Greenway Clinic last week. The doctor said the results would be ready today, but you have not received them. You call the clinic and hear the following conversation with the nurse.

questions.question: How can you find out your test results?
choices: Ask the nurse to read the results to you over the phone.
Come to the clinic on Monday to receive the results.
Wait at home until the results arrive in the mail.
Head to the clinic in person on Friday afternoon.
questions.explanation: 「Dr. Patel asked me not to share them over the phone」と「Dr. Patel is available on Friday afternoon」をつなぐ。結果は電話では伝えられず、金曜の午後に直接診察室で説明を受ける。月曜は予約がいっぱいなので、月曜に来るのは誤り。

title: Real-Life: Spring recital venue
situation: Your daughter is performing in the spring recital at Lakeside Music School. You hear the following message from the school on your phone.

questions.question: Where and when should your daughter arrive for the recital?
choices: Take her to the main hall on Sunday at six p.m.
Escort her to the side entrance of the small hall by five thirty.
Go to the small hall on Saturday at four p.m.
Enter the small hall through the main entrance at six p.m.
questions.explanation: 最後の案内は「the recital will take place in the small hall on Sunday at six p.m.」と「Performers must arrive at the side entrance by five thirty」。大ホールは壊れ、土曜の小ホールは結婚式で使われるため変更されている。正面の入口は保護者用で、出演者は通用口から入る。

title: Real-Life: Tennis court moved indoors
situation: You booked an outdoor tennis court at Westbridge Sports Club for this morning. When you arrive, you hear the following announcement.

questions.question: How can you play tennis today?
choices: Play on the outdoor courts once the rain stops.
Cancel the reservation and get a refund by mail.
Ask the coach for a private lesson at home.
Head to Court Two inside the Sports Hall.
questions.explanation: 「Your reserved court time has been moved to indoor Court Two in the Sports Hall.」より、予約した時間はスポーツホールの屋内2番コートで使う。屋外コートは大雨のため閉鎖されている。払い戻しやコーチのレッスンは本文にない内容。

title: Real-Life: Community bike repair clinic
situation: Your bicycle has a flat tire, and the brakes do not work well. You hear the following announcement from the community center.

questions.question: How can you make sure your bicycle is repaired on Saturday?
choices: Bring your electric bicycle for a frame repair.
Book a time slot on the website by Thursday.
Arrive at the community center on Saturday evening.
Buy spare parts from the volunteers on Thursday.
questions.explanation: 「please reserve a time slot on our website by Thursday」より、木曜日までにウェブサイトで時間枠を予約する。予約なしでも来られるが、必ず修理できるとは限らない。電動自転車やフレームは修理の対象外。

title: Real-Life: Orchestra rehearsal location
situation: You play the violin in a youth orchestra. You hear the following voicemail from the conductor's assistant.

questions.question: What should you do on Thursday if you play the violin?
choices: Arrive early at the upstairs music room of the community school.
Go to the main hall at the usual time.
Use the elevator to reach the second-floor room.
Go to the community school on Monday for the sectional.
questions.explanation: 「only the string players should bring their music stands」と「Everyone should arrive fifteen minutes early」をつなぐ。バイオリンは弦楽器なので、コミュニティスクールの2階の音楽室へ15分早く行く。主ホールは塗装中で、エレベーターは止まっている。月曜のパート練習は管楽器と金管楽器だけ。

title: Real-Life: Cinema seats for wheelchair users
situation: You use a wheelchair, and you want to watch a movie this Saturday with two friends at Star Cinema. You call the cinema and hear the following recorded message.

questions.question: How can you and your two friends sit together?
choices: Phone the cinema a day ahead to reserve the seats next to you.
Book the accessible seats online on the day of the show.
Arrive at the cinema fifteen minutes after the show starts.
Ask the box office to hold extra seats on the day.
questions.explanation: 「can be reserved only by phone」と「the front-row seats next to you will be held for you only if you book at least one day in advance」をつなぐ。電話で少なくとも1日前までに予約すれば、隣の席を確保できる。オンライン予約や当日の追加席は確保できない。

title: Real-Life: Rescheduled hospital appointment
situation: You have a hospital appointment on Tuesday. You hear the following message on your voicemail from Lakeside Medical Center.

questions.question: What should you do before your Thursday appointment?
choices: Go to Dr. Ito's office on Tuesday at ten a.m.
Obtain your blood test results from the second-floor laboratory before Thursday.
Visit the clinic on Wednesday for the rescheduled visit.
Have the results faxed to the clinic this week.
questions.explanation: 最後の案内は「Dr. Shah cannot see you unless you bring your blood test results」と「the laboratory is closed on Wednesdays」。火曜の予約は医師が休暇のため変更され、水曜の受診は取りやめ、結果のファックスも今回は不可と訂正されている。

title: Real-Life: Coffee shop loyalty card
situation: You are a regular customer at Bean Corner, and you have been collecting stamps on your loyalty card. You hear the following announcement at the shop.

questions.question: How can you get your free drink?
choices: Present your membership card at the register before ordering.
Pay for ten drinks at the counter in advance.
Mail your loyalty card to the head office.
Download a new card from the shop website.
questions.explanation: 「When you have ten stamps, you can get one free drink.」と「show your card at the register before you order」より、スタンプが10個たまったら、注文の前にレジでカードを見せる。ほかの選択肢は本文にない内容。

title: Real-Life: Address change at city hall
situation: You moved to a new apartment in the city last week. You visit the city hall counter and hear the following conversation with a staff member.

questions.question: How should you update your address today?
choices: Visit the post office to report your new address.
Send your lease agreement to the city hall by mail.
Present your residence card and lease agreement at this counter.
Wait two weeks before reporting your move.
questions.explanation: 「you need to bring your residence card and proof of your new address」と「a lease agreement is fine」より、窓口で住民カードと賃貸契約書を見せる。郵便局への届け出は不要で、引っ越しから14日以内に手続きする必要がある。

title: Real-Life: Campus parking permit change
situation: You are a new student who drives to campus. You hear the following announcement from the university's parking office.

questions.question: What should a new student do to park on campus?
choices: Visit the paper counter at the Student Center on Friday.
Wait for a plastic card at the Parking Office this week.
Submit an online request through the university portal and print the temporary permit.
Park in the reserved spaces until the card arrives.
questions.explanation: 「New students should apply through the university portal. Once approved, they can print a temporary permit at home.」より、新入生はポータルから申請し、承認されたら仮の許可証を自宅で印刷する。紙の窓口は金曜に閉まり、プラスチックのカードは学期の1週目のあとでしか受け取れない。

title: Real-Life: Health screening sign-up
situation: You are a forty-five-year-old resident of Westbridge City. You have not had a health check-up for three years. You hear the following announcement at the city hall.

questions.question: How can you join the free screening?
choices: Join the waiting list online, since you had a check-up two years ago.
Register on the day at the community hall before the session.
Send a letter to the city council by Friday.
Phone the hall by Wednesday to book a Saturday slot.
questions.explanation: 「Residents who have had a screening in the last two years are not eligible」より、3年前に受けた人は対象。「Appointments are made by phone」と「register by the Wednesday before the session」をつなぐ。水曜までに電話で予約する。当日受付やオンライン予約は、この事業では受け付けていない。

title: Real-Life: Sports day rain plan
situation: Your son is in the fourth grade at Oakridge Primary School. You hear the following message from the school.

questions.question: What should your son wear and bring on Saturday?
choices: Wear outdoor shoes and go to the main field at nine a.m.
Put on indoor trainers and pack a water bottle.
Put on indoor trainers and pack a towel.
Arrive at the school gate by twelve thirty.
questions.explanation: 最後の案内は「Students should wear indoor sports shoes, not outdoor shoes, and bring a water bottle」。運動会は体育館で午後1時から行う。メイングラウンドの午前9時は最初の案内で取り消され、タオルは本文にない。12時30分は保護者の集合時間。

title: Real-Life: Sunday engineering works
situation: You need to travel from Ashford to Kingsley this Sunday morning with a large suitcase. You hear the following announcement at Ashford Station.

questions.question: How should you travel to Kingsley on Sunday?
choices: Ride the Dunmore line and transfer at Dunmore.
Catch a replacement bus in front of the station.
Get a taxi voucher from the ticket office.
Board a replacement bus at the Elm Street car park.
questions.explanation: 大きなスーツケースを持っているので、「suitcases and other large items cannot be taken on the replacement buses」により振替バスは使えない。タクシー券も「the voucher scheme has now ended」で撤回され、最終的な案内は「passengers with large luggage should take a train on the Dunmore line ... and change at Dunmore for Kingsley」。駅前のバス乗り場は「please ignore that information」で取り消され、エルム・ストリート駐車場のバスは大きな荷物がなければ使える、ほかの乗客向けの案内。

title: Real-Life: First pilates class
situation: You want to start taking pilates classes at Harbor Wellness Studio. You have never done pilates before, and you work until seven p.m. on weekdays. You hear the following recorded message.

questions.question: What should you do first?
choices: Join the Tuesday beginner class at six p.m.
Call the studio to book an evening class.
Book a weekend class for beginners online.
Reserve a Saturday orientation on the website.
questions.explanation: 「anyone joining the studio for the first time must complete a thirty-minute safety orientation before taking any class」と「Orientations are held only on Saturday mornings, and they must be booked through our website, not by phone」をつなぐと、まず土曜日のオリエンテーションをウェブサイトで予約する必要がある。平日は午後7時まで仕事なので午後6時の初心者クラスには出られず、電話での予約は受け付けていない。週末のクラスは「for advanced members only」で初心者は受けられない。

title: Real-Life: Jazz festival day exchange
situation: You have a Saturday ticket for the Riverside Jazz Festival, but you now have to work on Saturday. You want to go on Sunday instead. You hear the following message on the festival's information line.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Swap your ticket in the festival app by Thursday.
Exchange your ticket at the box office on Sunday.
Ask for a refund because Sunday is sold out.
Buy a Sunday ticket at the gate on the day.
questions.explanation: 当日のチケット売り場での交換は「that service has now been withdrawn」で取り消され、最終的な方法は「all exchanges must be made through the official festival app, and the deadline is midnight this Thursday」。日曜日の完売も「a limited number of Sunday places have been released」で訂正され、その席は「available only to people exchanging a Saturday ticket」なので、土曜日のチケットを持つあなたは交換できる。払い戻しと入口での販売は「refunds are not available」「no tickets will be sold at the gate」で否定されている。

title: Real-Life: Cat not eating on Sunday
situation: Your cat has not eaten anything since this morning. It is now Sunday afternoon, and you call your local animal clinic. You hear the following recorded message.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Send a question through the online advice service.
Leave a message for the clinic on this line.
Call Riverside Animal Hospital before going there.
Take your cat to Maple Clinic on Monday morning.
questions.explanation: 「cats who stop eating can become seriously ill very quickly, so we treat this as an emergency」で、あなたの猫は緊急の扱いになる。「In an emergency, please go to Riverside Animal Hospital」と「Riverside asks owners to phone ahead before arriving」をつなぐと、リバーサイド動物病院に電話してから行けばよい。オンライン相談は一般的な質問向けで返事に最大1日かかり、留守番電話のメッセージは月曜日まで確認されない。月曜日まで待つのは緊急の対応にならない。

title: Real-Life: Apartment viewing rescheduled
situation: You booked a viewing of an apartment for this Friday at five p.m. You hear the following voicemail from the real estate agent, Mr. Clarke.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Go to the apartment on Friday at five p.m.
Show your ID at the agent's office on Saturday.
Meet Mr. Clarke at the apartment at ten.
Email a copy of your ID to Mr. Clarke.
questions.explanation: 金曜日の内見は「Friday's viewing can't go ahead」で中止、土曜日10時の案内も「another client has since taken that time」で撤回された。残る土曜日3時は一人で見るので「you'll need to pick up the keys from our office on Main Street」、そのためには「We can only hand over keys to people who show photo ID in person」。メールでのコピーは「we can't accept that」で却下されているので、土曜日に事務所で身分証明書を見せて鍵を受け取る。クラークさんと10時に会う予定はなくなっている。

title: Real-Life: Washing machine will not drain
situation: Your two-year-old washing machine will not drain, even after you cleaned the filter. You work on weekdays from nine a.m. to six p.m., but your adult brother, who is staying with you, is at home all day. You do not want to pay for the repair.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Book an evening visit for a time after you finish work.
Take the machine to the company's service center.
Clean the filter at the bottom front of the machine.
Book a weekday visit and enter your brother's name.
questions.explanation: 「Machines under three years old are covered by our warranty, but only for visits on weekdays between eight a.m. and four p.m.」から、無料にするには平日の日中の訪問が必要。あなたは平日の日中は仕事だが、「This does not have to be the account holder, but please enter that person's name when you book」から、家にいる兄の名前を入力して予約すればよい。夜間の訪問は「for a fee of eighty dollars」で有料、持ち込みは「we do not accept machines brought to our service center」で受け付けていない。フィルターはすでに掃除してある。

title: Real-Life: Umbrella left on a bus
situation: You left your umbrella on a city bus five days ago. You finish work at six p.m. on weekdays and are busy all weekend. You call the bus company and hear the following message.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Visit the depot at the end of the bus route.
Go to the central office on Saturday morning.
Send a photo of the umbrella to the depot.
Go to the King Street office on a weekday evening.
questions.explanation: 落とし物は「kept for two days at the depot」の後、「sent to our central lost property office on King Street」となる。5日前に置き忘れたので、傘はもうキング通りの中央センターにある。中央センターは「open until eight p.m. on weekdays」なので、6時に仕事が終わった後の平日の夕方に行ける。車庫は2日しか保管せず、平日5時までしか開いていない。土曜日は週末で予定がある。写真を送るという案内はなく、写真付きの身分証を持参するように言っているだけ。

title: Real-Life: Spanish class canceled
situation: You signed up for a beginner Spanish class at a community center that was going to start next Tuesday. You work late on Tuesdays and Wednesdays. You want to keep learning Spanish, and you prefer to study in person. You hear the following voicemail from the center.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Call back and ask to join the Thursday class.
Call back and sign up for the Wednesday class.
Call back and ask for a refund of your fee.
Call back and ask to move to the Saturday class.
questions.explanation: 木曜日のクラスは一度「still has a few seats left」と案内されたが、「the last seats in the Thursday class were taken this morning」と訂正された。水曜日のクラスは「held online only」で、あなたは水曜日も遅くまで仕事がある。残るのは「a new Saturday morning class here at the center」で、センターで対面で学べる。スペイン語を続けたいので、返金ではなく土曜日のクラスへの変更を申し込めばよい。

title: Real-Life: Returning a winter coat
situation: You bought a winter coat at full price at a department store 20 days ago. You have not worn it, but you have lost the receipt. You paid with your credit card, and you want your money back. You call the store and hear the following message.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Take the card you paid with to the fourth-floor counter.
Bring the coat and your card to any regular register.
Ask for store credit at the fourth-floor counter.
Exchange the coat for a sale item on the fourth floor.
questions.explanation: レシートがないと通常は店内用のクレジットだけだが、「if you paid by card, please bring the card you used」で「give you a full refund」と例外がある。あなたはカードで払い、お金を返してほしいので、支払いに使ったカードを持って行けばよい。さらに返金は「at the service counter on the fourth floor, not at the regular registers」なので、4階のカウンターに行く。通常のレジでは返金を受けられない。店内用のクレジットはお金が戻らず、あなたの希望に合わない。セール品と交換するという案内はなく、セールの話は返品の条件として出ただけ。

title: Real-Life: Getting to an island during pier repairs
situation: You are staying in a seaside town and want to visit Gull Island tomorrow. You have a tourist pass that covers the town's buses and trams but not boats. You want to spend as little money as possible. You hear the following message from the tourist information center.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Catch the free boat at the main harbor.
Hire a water taxi at North Point.
Take the bus that crosses to the island.
Book a guided kayak trip with lunch.
questions.explanation: 無料の代替船は一度案内されたが、「that service has now been canceled because of a shortage of crew」と取り消された。水上タクシーは「twenty dollars each way」で、パスは船に使えない。カヤックツアーも有料のツアー。「the bridge to the island from the east coast reopened this morning, and the Number 12 bus now crosses it」とあり、パスはバスに使えるので、バスで島へ渡るのがいちばんお金がかからない。

title: Real-Life: Guitar lessons for a beginner
situation: You want to take guitar lessons at a music school. You have never played before, and you do not want to buy a guitar until you are sure you will continue. You can only take lessons on weekday evenings. You call the school and hear the following message.

questions.question: What should you do first?
choices: Press two to schedule a short talk with the school.
Sign up for the beginners' course on Saturdays.
Buy a guitar so that you can join a group class.
Ask the front desk to choose a teacher for you.
questions.explanation: 平日の夜しか通えないので、「Private lessons are available on weekday evenings」から個人レッスンを選ぶことになる。ギターは「Rental guitars are for private lesson students only」で個人レッスンなら借りられる。そして「Before their first private lesson, all new students must attend a free fifteen-minute meeting」とあり、「To arrange this meeting, please press two」と言っている。まず2を押して面談を予約すればよい。土曜日のグループ講座は平日の夜という条件に合わず、自分の楽器も必要。ギターを買うのは、続けると決めるまで買いたくないという条件に反する。受付はギターを借りる場所で、講師は面談で決める。

title: Real-Life: Community garden plot
situation: You live in Eastfield and want to rent a plot at a community garden this spring. You have not applied yet. You work on Saturdays but are free on Sundays. You hear the following message from the city parks office.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Complete the orientation through the website instead.
Book a place at one of the Saturday orientations.
Wait and put your name on next year's waiting list.
Apply on the website and then attend the added session.
questions.explanation: 説明会は「Sessions are held on Saturday mornings」だが、あなたは土曜日は仕事で、しかも「The Saturday sessions are now full」。オンラインの説明会は「that option is no longer available」と訂正で取り消された。残るのは「An extra session has been added on Sunday, March fifth, for applicants who have already applied」で、まだ申し込んでいないので、先にウェブサイトで申し込み、日曜日の追加の説明会に出ればよい。来年の名簿に回るのは説明会に出なかった場合で、今年借りたいという希望に合わない。

title: Real-Life: Catering for an anniversary dinner
situation: You are holding a dinner at home on Saturday for your parents' wedding anniversary. Twelve people will come, and two of them cannot eat wheat. You want the food brought to your house. Today is Tuesday. You call a catering company and hear the following message.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Order the Family Feast set on the website.
Press one and ask for the Garden set.
Press two and choose an anniversary cake.
Ask for changes to the Family Feast set.
questions.explanation: 12人のうち2人が小麦を食べられないので、「every dish in it is prepared without wheat」で「serves up to twelve people」のガーデン・セットが合う。家に届けてほしいが、「online orders are for shop pickup only. Delivery orders must be made by phone」とあり、電話で頼むには「To place an order by phone, press one」。今日は火曜日なので、土曜日の配達にも間に合う。ファミリー・フィースト・セットには「pasta and bread」が入り、ウェブサイトの注文は店頭受け取りだけ。2はケーキの案内で、料理の注文ではない。ファミリー・フィースト・セットは「cannot be changed」。

title: Real-Life: Starting water service at a new home
situation: You are moving into a house in Brookfield this Saturday, and you need running water from that day. You submitted an online request to start water service on March fifteenth, but you have not received a confirmation email. You work from home and are free to make calls during the day. You call the city water department and hear the following message.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Fill out the online request form once more.
Wait a few more days for the confirmation email.
Request the service again by talking to the desk on the phone.
Go to the counter at city hall on Thursday evening.
questions.explanation: あなたは3月15日にオンラインで申し込み、確認メールが届いていないので、「online requests submitted between March tenth and March twentieth were not received」に当たり、申し込みは失われている。以前は申込書の再記入を勧めていたが、「this is no longer recommended」と撤回された。代わりに「please contact our service desk by pressing two」で、電話なら「in time for weekend move-ins」と土曜日の引っ越しに間に合う。あなたは日中に電話できるので、電話で申し込み直せばよい。確認メールは申し込みが失われているので待っても届かない。市役所の窓口は「processed the following week」で、引っ越しに間に合わず、日中に電話できない人のための方法。

title: Real-Life: Kayak tour with a child
situation: You want to go kayaking with your ten-year-old son. Neither of you has ever paddled before. You are free only on Sunday afternoon. You call a tour company and hear the following message.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Go online to arrange a lesson for you and your son.
Press one to reserve two places on the Sunset Tour.
Book the Harbor Tour for you and your son on Sunday.
Ask a guide to rent a separate kayak for your son.
questions.explanation: あなたは日曜日の午後しか空いておらず、2人とも初心者。日曜日の午後のサンセットツアーは「it is for experienced paddlers only」なので参加できない。ハーバーツアーは初心者向けだが「Saturday and Sunday mornings」で午前しかない。そこで「Beginners who cannot join a morning tour can take a private lesson」「Lessons are offered every afternoon」を使い、「Private lessons can be booked on our website」とあるので、ウェブサイトで親子のレッスンを予約すればよい。1を押すのはグループツアーの予約で、サンセットツアーは経験者向け。ハーバーツアーは午前だけ。息子は「must share a two-person kayak with an adult」なので、別のカヤックは借りられない。

title: Real-Life: First visit to a climbing wall
situation: You want to try the climbing wall at a sports center for the first time this Saturday. You do not have your own climbing shoes. You call the center and hear the following message.

questions.question: What should you do first?
choices: Buy a day pass at the front desk on Saturday.
Reserve a spot in a safety lesson online.
Purchase a pair of climbing shoes at a shop.
Arrive at nine a.m. and start climbing.
questions.explanation: 初めて登るので「First-time visitors must complete a one-hour safety class before climbing」に当てはまり、「places must be booked on our website in advance」とある。まずウェブサイトで安全講習の席を予約すればよい。受付で1日券を買えるのは「Experienced climbers」で、初めての人には当てはまらない。靴は「can be rented at the front desk」で、店で買う必要はない。午前9時に開くが、講習を受けるまでは登れない。

title: Real-Life: Second interview options
situation: You have applied for a job at a software company and passed the first interview. Because of your current job, you cannot attend anything on weekdays before 2 p.m. You hear the following voicemail from the company's recruiter.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Reply and request the manager's Thursday slot.
Reply and choose the video interview on Wednesday.
Reply and ask to meet the technical lead on Friday.
Reply and accept the manager's Tuesday interview.
questions.explanation: あなたは平日の午後2時より前は参加できないので、火曜日の午前10時は選べない。木曜日の午後3時は一度案内されたが「the Thursday slot has already been given to another candidate」と訂正された。水曜日のビデオ面接は「the second interview must be held in person, so that wouldn't count」で二次面接にならない。残るのは「our technical lead can do the in-person interview instead, on Friday at 5 p.m.」で、二次面接として認められ、時間も午後2時より後。

title: Real-Life: Cordless vacuum cleaner will not charge
situation: Your cordless vacuum cleaner has stopped charging. You bought it fourteen months ago and still have the receipt. You do not want to be without a vacuum cleaner for more than a few days. You call the manufacturer's support line and hear the following message.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Send proof of purchase online to get a free part.
Press one to have the machine fixed at the center.
Buy a new battery because the warranty has ended.
Mail the cleaner in and wait for a free repair.
questions.explanation: 購入から14か月なので本体の「one-year warranty」は切れているが、「Batteries, however, are covered for two years」とあり、充電できない原因は「usually the battery」なので、バッテリーは無料で交換してもらえる。新しいバッテリーは「within three business days」に届き、数日以上掃除機なしで過ごしたくないという条件にも合う。依頼には「upload a photo of your receipt on our website」とあるので、オンラインで購入の証明を送ればよい。1を押すと修理になり、修理センターでの修理は「two to three weeks」かかって条件に合わない(本体ごと送る選択肢も同じ)。保証が切れたのは本体だけで、バッテリーは保証の対象なので買う必要はない。

title: Real-Life: Training class for a young dog
situation: You have just adopted a five-month-old puppy, and it has had all of its vaccinations. You want to join a training class, but you can only attend on weekday evenings. You hear the following message from an animal training center.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Sign up for the class that meets on Tuesday and Thursday nights.
Arrange an evaluation online, then join the new midweek class.
Have your puppy checked by a trainer during its first lesson.
Join the Good Manners class that is held on Saturday mornings.
questions.explanation: 子犬は生後5か月なので、「Puppy Basics class is for dogs up to four months old」の火曜・木曜の夜のクラスには入れない。対象になる Good Manners は「Saturday mornings」だが、平日の夜しか通えない。ところが「an evening group for Good Manners will be added on Wednesdays」と変更があり、水曜日の夜のグループなら通える。さらに4か月を超える犬は「must also book a short assessment before joining」で、最初のクラスで受けられるという以前の案内は「That is no longer the case」と取り消され、「book one on our website」とある。ウェブサイトで適性チェックを予約してから、新しい水曜日のクラスに入ればよい。最初のクラスで見てもらうのは取り消された案内。土曜日の午前のクラスは平日の夜という条件に合わない。

title: Real-Life: Extended hours at a city nursery
situation: You applied last month for a place for your two-year-old son at a public nursery starting in April. You work full-time and finish work at 6 p.m. on weekdays. You call the city's childcare office and hear the following message.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Wait for the nursery results to arrive by mail.
Submit a new nursery application on the website.
Mail a form along with proof of your work hours.
Press two to ask about the extended-care service.
questions.explanation: あなたは午後6時まで働くので、「our nurseries normally close at 5:30 p.m.」では迎えに間に合わず、「Children whose parents work until 6 p.m. or later may use our extended-care service」に当てはまる。延長保育は「cannot be added after places have been decided」で、すでに申し込んだ人は「send us an extended-care form by February 1」とある。提出は「returned by mail, together with a letter from your employer showing your working hours」なので、勤務時間の証明と一緒に申請書を郵送すればよい。結果を待つだけでは、入園先が決まった後に延長保育を追加できない。申込みはすでに済んでおり、締め切りも過ぎている。2を押すと保育料の問い合わせになり、延長保育の申し込みにはならない。

title: Real-Life: One-semester exchange programs
situation: You want to study abroad for one semester next year. Your scholarship pays only for programs at your university's partner schools, and you need to take courses taught in English. You hear the following message from your university's study abroad office.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Send the web form for the school in Ireland.
Apply for the English courses at Lindgren.
Ask Ferreira about its classes in English.
Book a meeting to talk about summer study.
questions.explanation: リンドグレン大学は授業が英語だが、「Lindgren left our partner program this year, so students going there now have to pay their own fees」と訂正され、提携校でなくなったので奨学金が使えない。フェレイラ大学は提携校だが「the English ones are open only to graduate students」で、英語の授業を受けられない。ハートウェル・カレッジは「also a partner, where classes are in English」で、締め切りについても「that was my mistake. Applications are accepted until the end of this month」と訂正されている。申し込みは「submit the online form on our website」なので、アイルランドの学校のフォームをウェブで送ればよい。夏のプログラムは1学期間の留学ではない。

title: Real-Life: Getting a checked-out library book
situation: You need a book for an essay due in five days, and you must read several chapters of it. The university library's only copy has been borrowed by another student. You will be on campus every day this week, and you do not want to pay any fees. You call the library and hear the following message.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Place a hold on the library's own copy.
Request that staff scan and send a chapter.
Pay to have the book brought to your home.
Ask online for a copy from another school.
questions.explanation: 予約は「The current borrower will then have up to ten days to return it」で、5日後の締め切りに間に合わないおそれがある。相互貸借は「It's free, and most books arrive within three days」で、受け取りは「They must be picked up at the main service desk」だが、あなたは今週毎日大学にいるので受け取れる。申し込みは「use the online form on our website」なので、ほかの大学の本をウェブで取り寄せればよい。スキャンは「one chapter」だけで、何章も読む必要があるあなたには足りない。自宅への配達は「five dollars per item」かかり、しかも当館の蔵書は貸し出し中。

title: Real-Life: Covered bicycle parking at a station
situation: Starting next month, you will ride your bicycle to Oakwood Station on weekdays and leave it there from 7 a.m. until about 8 p.m. You want your bicycle to be kept under a roof, and you want to spend as little as possible. You hear the following announcement at the station.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Apply at the station office for a covered rack by the bus terminal.
Buy a discounted weekday pass for the garage at the south exit.
Park your bicycle for free in the racks beside the north exit.
Get a monthly pass for the south exit garage from the machine.
questions.explanation: 北口の無料のラックは「open-air」で屋根がなく、「any bicycle left there after 6 p.m. will be removed」なので午後8時まで置けない。南口の駐輪場で平日だけの50ドルの定期券は「that plan has been canceled」と取り消された。残るのは南口の駐輪場(「eighty dollars a month」)と、来月からのバスターミナル横の屋根付きラック(「sixty dollars a month」「can be used until 9 p.m.」)で、どちらも屋根があり午後8時まで置けるが、安いのはバスターミナル横のラック。申し込みは「accepted at the station office from the first of the month」なので、駅の事務室でバスターミナル横のラックを申し込めばよい。平日割引の定期券は中止された。券売機で買う南口の定期券は条件に合うが、より高い。

title: Real-Life: Weekend entry to a special exhibition
situation: You are a member of a history museum. You want to see its special exhibition this Saturday with your eight-year-old son, and you do not want to wait in line. You call the museum and hear the following message.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Book both of your tickets together on the museum's website.
Show your membership card at the exhibition entrance.
Buy two same-day tickets at the front desk on Saturday.
Reserve your own ticket and pay for your son's at the door.
questions.explanation: 会員は「Members can reserve weekend tickets free of charge on the members' page of our website」で週末のチケットを無料で予約でき、12歳未満の子ども1人も無料だが「the child's ticket must be added to the same reservation」とある。2か所をつなぐと、ウェブサイトで自分と息子のチケットを1つの予約にまとめて取ればよい。会員証を見せるだけでは「will need to join the regular line」で列に並ぶことになる。受付の当日券は週末は「usually sell out by ten a.m.」で列も長い。息子の分は同じ予約に入れれば無料で、入口で払うのではない。

title: Real-Life: Cycling to a park concert after rain
situation: You are going to a free outdoor concert in Riverside Park tonight. You will ride your bicycle there. You hear the following announcement on the radio.

questions.question: What should you do when you arrive?
choices: Enter from the north and leave your bike with helpers.
Leave your bike in the lot on Station Street.
Go into the park through the gate on Mill Road.
Head straight to the lawn next to the river.
questions.explanation: 自転車で来る人には「please come in through the north gate, where volunteers will be looking after bicycles free of charge」とあるので、北から入ってボランティアに自転車を預ければよい。ステーション通りの駐車場は「If you're coming by car」と車で来る人向け。ミル通りの正門は「will be closed all evening」。川沿いの芝生は「too wet」でステージは運動場に移された。

title: Real-Life: Gift wrapping at a department store
situation: You bought a birthday present for a friend's party tonight, and you want it gift-wrapped. You hear the following announcement at the department store.

questions.question: Where should you go to get your present wrapped?
choices: To the information booth by the main entrance.
To the gift shop in the basement.
To the cashier on the second floor.
To the customer service desk on the fourth floor.
questions.explanation: 「Today, the wrapping counter on the first floor is closed」に続けて「please take your items to the customer service desk on the fourth floor」と言っている。今日は4階のサービスデスクに持って行く。正面入口の案内所、地下のギフトショップ、2階のレジは放送に出てこない。

title: Real-Life: Picking up tulip bulbs before a flower show
situation: You ordered tulip bulbs from a garden center to plant this weekend. You can only go to the garden center on Saturday afternoon, and you will not be at home on Friday. You hear the following voice message from the garden center.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Ask the garden center to deliver your bulbs on Friday.
Go to the service desk at around 5 p.m. on Saturday.
Wait until the grower sends the bulbs next week.
Collect your order no later than 3 p.m. on Saturday.
questions.explanation: 「this Saturday we'll close at three o'clock」とある。土曜日の午後しか行けないので、閉店の3時までに受け取りに行く。金曜日の配達は、金曜日は家にいないので受け取れない。5時ごろは通常なら営業中だが、この土曜日は閉まっている。球根は「arrived from the grower yesterday」で、もう届いている。

title: Real-Life: An overnight guest at a share house
situation: You live in a share house. A friend is visiting this Saturday and will stay one night. You were hoping she could use the guest room. The house manager says the following at a house meeting.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Reserve the guest room on the kitchen whiteboard.
Get the landlord's permission for her stay.
Tell the manager about her when she arrives.
List her name early and share your room.
questions.explanation: 泊まる客については「please write their name on the whiteboard in the kitchen at least two days before they arrive」とあり、さらに「This weekend, though, the guest room is being repainted, so any overnight guests will have to sleep in your own room」と言っている。前もって台所のボードに名前を書き、友人には自分の部屋に泊まってもらえばよい。ホワイトボードに書くのは客の名前で、来客用の部屋は今週末は塗り替えのため使えない。大家さんの許可は「Anyone staying longer」、つまり3泊より長い場合だけ必要で、1泊なら要らない。到着してから知らせるのでは、2日前までに書くという決まりに合わない。

title: Real-Life: A new meeting place for a photo workshop
situation: You signed up for a beginners' photography workshop this Saturday. You will take pictures with your smartphone. You hear the following message from the instructor.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Head to the botanical garden by ten o'clock.
Bring an extra memory card for your phone.
Get to the ferry terminal ahead of the start time.
Buy a camera app before the workshop begins.
questions.explanation: あなたはスマートフォンで撮影する。スマートフォンの人には「Please arrive fifteen minutes early, and I'll help you install a free app」と言っており、集合場所は「we'll meet at the harbor instead, in front of the ferry terminal」なので、開始時刻より早くフェリーターミナルに着けばよい。植物園は「will be closed for repairs」で、集合場所は港に変わった。予備のメモリーカードは「If you're bringing a digital camera」の人への案内。アプリは「free」で、当日に入れるのを手伝ってもらえるので、前もって買う必要はない。

title: Real-Life: A wallet left on a sightseeing bus
situation: You are traveling in Harbor City. This morning, you took a sightseeing bus tour, and you think you left your wallet on the tour bus. You want to get it back today if possible. You call the tourist information center and hear the following message.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Find out how to reach the company that ran your tour.
Call the lost property office of the transit authority.
Go to the central police station tomorrow afternoon.
Ask at the reception desk of the place you visited.
questions.explanation: 交通局の遺失物取扱所は市バスや電車の落とし物の窓口だが、「items left on sightseeing tour buses are not handled by the transit authority」と否定されている。ツアーバスの落とし物は「kept by each tour company at its own office until closing time that day」なので、今日中に取り戻すにはツアー会社に連絡すればよい。連絡先は「To get the address and phone number of a tour company, please press two now」で分かる。中央警察署で受け取れるのは翌日の午後2時以降で、今日取り戻したいという条件に合わない。施設の受付は美術館などでなくした場合の窓口で、ツアーバスは対象ではない。

title: Real-Life: Spending a last day after hotel check-out
situation: You are checking out of your hotel tomorrow. You want to go sightseeing until about 5 p.m. without carrying your suitcase. You also want to take a shower before you leave for the airport at 7 p.m. You hear the following message from the front desk.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Pay for late check-out so that you can take a shower in your room.
Store your luggage and use the free showers in the fitness center.
Skip the shower, since none can be used once you have checked out.
Leave your suitcase at the front desk and reserve a shower at the spa.
questions.explanation: レイトチェックアウトは「until 3 p.m.」までなので、午後5時まで観光してから部屋でシャワーを浴びることはできない。フィットネスセンターの無料のシャワーは「the fitness center will be closed all day tomorrow ... this service will not be available」と取り消された。代わりに「guests who have checked out may use the showers at our spa ... until 8 p.m.」とあり、「Please book a time at the front desk」と予約が必要。荷物は無料で預けられ、明日は「luggage storage will close at 6 p.m., not 10 p.m.」と訂正されたが、午後5時に戻れば受け取れる。荷物をフロントに預け、スパのシャワーを予約すればよい。チェックアウト後に使えるシャワーはないというのは、取り消されたフィットネスセンターの話だけを聞いた場合の誤り。

title: Real-Life: A walking tour with a toddler in a stroller
situation: You are visiting a city with your two-year-old son, who rides in a large stroller. You want to join a walking tour today. The weather forecast says it will be sunny all day. You hear the following announcement at a visitor center.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Join the tour that starts at ten and visits the castle.
Buy a ticket only for yourself, since your son is free.
Bring a folding stroller to take on the bus tour.
Get tickets for yourself and your son in advance.
questions.explanation: ベビーカーで参加できるのは「The route is flat, so it's suitable for strollers」と案内された午後のツアー。チケットは「must be bought here at the counter at least thirty minutes before the tour begins」で、子どもは無料でも「they still need a ticket of their own」なので、自分と息子のチケットを前もって買えばよい。午前のツアーはお城に「strollers cannot be taken inside」。子どもが無料でもチケットは必要。バスツアーは雨の場合だけで、今日は一日晴れの予報。

title: Real-Life: A refund for a concert moved to a new date
situation: You bought two tickets for an outdoor concert on July 20 at a convenience store near your office. You will be away on a business trip on the new date of the concert, so you want your money back. You hear the following message from the ticket office.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Log in to your account and ask for a refund.
Bring the tickets to the concert venue.
Keep the tickets, since they are still valid.
Take the tickets and receipt to the store you used.
questions.explanation: あなたはチケットをオフィス近くのコンビニで買い、新しい日付には出張で行けない。放送では「Tickets bought at convenience stores must be returned to the store where you bought them, together with your receipt」と言っているので、チケットと領収書を買った店に持っていけばよい。ログインして申し込むのはウェブサイトで買った場合。会場では「refunds cannot be given」。チケットは新しい日付でも有効だが、あなたはその日に行けないので払い戻しが必要。

title: Real-Life: A bread class for someone with a nut allergy
situation: You signed up for a bread-making class at a cooking school this Saturday. You have a nut allergy. You still want to take a class this weekend. You hear the following message from the school.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Bring an apron to the class on Saturday.
Call the school by Thursday to cancel.
Check the Web site for the new recipe.
Respond to the message the school sent by e-mail.
questions.explanation: あなたはナッツアレルギーで、土曜日はクルミのパンを作ることになった。それでも今週末に教室を受けたい。放送では「Students who cannot eat nuts are welcome to move to our Sunday class ... Just reply to the e-mail we sent you this morning」と言っているので、メールに返信して日曜日の教室に移ればよい。エプロンを持っていくのは土曜日にそのまま参加する場合。キャンセルするとこの週末に教室を受けられない。ウェブサイトに載っているのは変更前のロールパン。

title: Real-Life: Taking a bicycle on a weekend train
situation: You want to take your bicycle on a train to Westfield this Saturday morning. Your bicycle cannot be folded. You hear the following announcement at the station.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Fold your bicycle before you get on the train.
Use the elevator when you arrive at Westfield.
Ask a station worker for a free bike ticket.
Take a train after 10 a.m. and ride in the last car.
questions.explanation: あなたの自転車は折りたためない。放送では、折りたたみ以外の自転車は「only on trains leaving after 10 a.m.」で「placed in the last car」と言っているので、10時以降の列車の最後尾の車両に乗ればよい。土曜日の朝でも10時以降なら乗れる。自転車をたたむのは折りたたみ自転車の場合。ウェストフィールド駅のエレベーターは「out of service」。自転車用の切符は3ドルで、無料ではない。

title: Real-Life: A fitness club plan for early mornings
situation: You want to join a fitness club. You work until 8 p.m. on weekdays, so you can only exercise before work, starting at 6:30 a.m. You also want to use the swimming pool. You hear the following explanation from a staff member.

questions.question: Which plan should you choose?
choices: The Standard plan.
The Early Bird plan.
The Weekend plan.
The Premium plan.
questions.explanation: あなたは平日は夜8時まで働くので、運動できるのは仕事前の朝6時半から。さらにプールも使いたい。スタンダードは「from 9 a.m.」で朝早くは使えない。アーリーバードは朝6時から使えるが「does not include the pool」。ウィークエンドは「only on Saturdays and Sundays」で平日の朝に使えない。プレミアムは「every facility at any time we are open」で、開館の朝6時からプールも使えるので、条件をすべて満たす。

title: Real-Life: A Saturday flu shot
situation: You want to get a flu shot. You work from 9 a.m. to 6 p.m. on weekdays, so you can only visit the clinic on a Saturday. You call the clinic and hear the following recorded message.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Visit the clinic on a weekday afternoon.
Call the clinic to book a time this Saturday.
Go to the clinic on Saturday without booking.
Reserve online once next month's slots open.
questions.explanation: あなたは平日は午後6時まで働いているので、平日の午後2時〜5時には行けない。土曜日は「by appointment only」で、今月分は「already full」。来月分は「will open on our Web site on the 25th」なので、来月分の受付が始まってからオンラインで予約すればよい。今週の土曜日はもう空きがなく、電話で予約するとも言っていない。土曜日は予約なしでは受けられない。

title: Real-Life: Free parking at a shopping mall
situation: You drove to a shopping mall and parked in its garage. You bought some shoes, but you did not see a movie. You want to park for free. You hear the following announcement.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Go to the movie theater on the fourth floor.
Buy something else at the shoe store.
Pay at a machine in the parking garage.
Show your receipt at the counter on the first floor.
questions.explanation: 放送では、駐車券には「at the information counter on the first floor」でスタンプを押してもらえ、「your parking ticket and a receipt from any store」を持っていくよう言っている。あなたは靴を買ったのでレシートがある。それを1階のカウンターで見せればよい。4階の映画館は映画を見た人だけ。靴をもう一度買う必要はない。駐車場の機械で払う話はない。

title: Real-Life: Documents that must arrive tomorrow
situation: You need to send some documents to a client in another city. The documents must arrive tomorrow. It is now 4 p.m., and you are at the post office. You hear the following announcement.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Go to the counter with the evening option.
Send the documents by express mail at Counter 1.
Send the documents by regular mail.
Come back before 3 p.m. tomorrow.
questions.explanation: あなたは午後4時に郵便局にいて、書類は明日届かなければならない。午後3時以降の速達は「arrives in two days」なので間に合わない。放送では「If you need next-day delivery after 3 p.m., please use our Night Priority service ... at Counter 5 only」と言っているので、5番窓口で夜間優先サービスを使えばよい。普通郵便は3〜4日かかる。明日の午後3時前に出すと届くのは明後日になる。

title: Real-Life: A castle tour for a father who cannot climb stairs
situation: You are visiting a castle with your father, who has trouble walking up stairs. You both want a tour in English. You must leave the castle by 2 p.m. You hear the following announcement at the ticket office.

questions.question: Which tour should you take?
choices: The Tower Tour.
The Great Hall Tour.
The Kitchen Tour.
The Garden Tour.
questions.explanation: 父親は階段を上るのが難しく、ツアーは英語がよく、午後2時までに城を出なければならない。タワー・ツアーは「climbing two hundred steps」がある。大広間ツアーは英語でエレベーターもあるが「doesn't end until 2:30」で間に合わない。厨房ツアーは「offered only in German」。ガーデン・ツアーは英語があり、「The path is flat all the way」で、12時半に終わるので、すべての条件に合う。

title: Real-Life: A new meeting point for a ferry trip
