situation: You signed up for a ferry tour to Mira Island this Sunday. You plan to drive to the port. You hear the following message from the tour company.

questions.question: What should you do on Sunday?
choices: Park in a reserved space next to Pier 7.
Meet the tour group at Pier 3 at 8:30.
Get off the bus at the Pier 7 stop.
Leave your car at a shopping center and ride a shuttle.
questions.explanation: あなたは車で港に行く。駐車場の場所の確保は「the port has told us that this is not allowed」で取りやめになり、「if you're driving, please park at the Harbor Mall garage and take our free shuttle」と案内されている。モールに車を止めてシャトルに乗ればよい。7番桟橋の隣に確保した場所は使えない。3番桟橋に8時半に集まるのは取り消された古い案内。バスを降りるのはバスで来る人の場合。

title: Real-Life: Weekend assembly for a new bookshelf
situation: You bought a $350 bookshelf from a furniture store and want someone to put it together. You can be at home only on Saturdays and Sundays. You call the store and hear the following message.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Press 1 to book a free visit.
Press 2 to talk to the delivery team.
Ask the store to visit you on a weekday.
Make a booking on the store's website.
questions.explanation: あなたは土日しか家にいないので、週末の訪問が必要。放送では「Weekend visits cannot be booked by phone, so please use the form on our website」と言っているので、ウェブサイトで予約すればよい。1を押すと予約できるのは平日の訪問で、無料なのも平日だけ。2は配送についての質問の番号。平日に来てもらっても、あなたは家にいない。

title: Real-Life: Returning a sweater without a receipt
situation: You want to return a sweater that you bought at a department store last week. You do not have the receipt. You hear the following announcement at the customer service counter.

questions.question: What will you probably receive?
choices: Your money back for the sweater.
A new receipt for your purchase.
Credit that you can spend at the store.
A discount on your next sweater.
questions.explanation: あなたはレシートを持っていない。放送では「If you do not have your receipt, we can give you a store gift card for the value of the item」と言っている。店で使えるギフトカードがもらえるので、正解はその言い換え。代金が返ってくるのはレシートがある場合。新しいレシートを出す、次のセーターが割引になる、という話はない。

title: Real-Life: Getting to the airport when the express train stops
situation: You are at a train station with an Airport Express ticket. You want to go to Greenfield Airport, and you need to be there within two hours. You hear the following announcement.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Wait for the Airport Express to start again.
Take the airport bus from the north exit.
Buy a new ticket for the trip to the airport.
Board a train that stops at every station.
questions.explanation: あなたは2時間以内に空港に着かなければならない。空港急行は「not running this morning」で使えない。バスは「the trip currently takes more than two hours」で間に合わない。各駅停車は約70分で、「Airport Express tickets can be used on the local train」なので、今の切符のまま4番線の各駅停車に乗ればよい。新しい切符を買う必要はない。

title: Real-Life: A cooking class for a beginner with a shellfish allergy
situation: You want to take a cooking class for beginners on a weekday evening. You are allergic to shellfish. You hear the following message from a cooking school.

questions.question: Which class should you take?
choices: Vegetable Curry.
Japanese Home Cooking.
Italian Pasta.
French Sauces.
questions.explanation: 条件は「初心者向け」「平日の夜」「甲殻類を使わない」の3つ。日本の家庭料理は平日の夜で初心者向けだが「several dishes in this course use shrimp」なので合わない。イタリアのパスタは土曜日の午前。フランスのソースは「For more experienced cooks」。野菜カレーは水曜日の夜で「welcomes students of all levels」、さらに「no meat or seafood is used」なので、すべての条件に合う。

title: Real-Life: Getting to the airport when a hotel shuttle is canceled
situation: You are staying at a hotel. Your flight leaves tomorrow at 11 a.m., and you need to be at the airport by 9:30 a.m. You hear the following message from the front desk.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Take the shuttle that leaves at 8 a.m. tomorrow.
Wait for a taxi that the hotel will pay for.
Ride the shuttle that leaves at 10 a.m. tomorrow.
Put your name on a list at the front desk tonight.
questions.explanation: あなたは午前9時半までに空港に着く必要がある。午前8時のシャトルは「will not run」。代わりのタクシーも「they cannot send enough cars」で取りやめになった。最終的な案内は、支配人が8時15分にバンで送るので「Please sign up at the front desk by 10 p.m. tonight」。今夜フロントで申し込めばよい。午前10時のシャトルは運行するが、9時半には間に合わない。

title: Real-Life: Buying a student bus pass
situation: You are a university student, and you want to buy a monthly bus pass with the student discount. You hear the following announcement at the bus center.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Buy your pass from the bus driver.
Buy your pass at a train station.
Buy your pass on the Internet.
Buy your pass at Window 2.
questions.explanation: あなたは学生割引で定期券を買いたい。放送では「Students who want the student discount must buy their pass at Window 2」と言っている。2番窓口で買えばよい。運転手から買う、駅で買う、インターネットで買う、という話はない。

title: Real-Life: Picking up a repaired watch on a Sunday
situation: You left your watch at a shop to have its battery replaced. You can only go to pick it up on Sunday. You hear the following voice message.

questions.question: What should you do first?
choices: Contact the shop by Saturday.
Go to the main shop on Sunday.
Pick up the watch on Monday.
Ask for a new battery.
questions.explanation: あなたは日曜日にしか行けない。日曜日に開いているのはグランドモールのカウンターだけで、そこで受け取るには「please call us by Saturday so that we can send it over to the mall」と言っている。土曜日までに店に連絡するので、正解はその言い換え。本店(main shop)は日曜日は休み。月曜日には行けない。電池はもう交換してある。

title: Real-Life: A city pool for weekday evenings
situation: You want to swim after work on weekdays. You finish work at 6:30 p.m. and do not have a car. You hear the following information about city pools.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Swim at Westside Pool after you finish work.
Take a bus to Northgate Pool in the evening.
Swim at Riverside Pool every Monday evening.
Swim at Riverside Pool on days other than Monday.
questions.explanation: あなたは6時半に仕事が終わり、車がない。ウエストサイドは「open on weekdays until six p.m.」で間に合わない。ノースゲートは「can only be reached by car」で行けない。リバーサイドは9時まで開いていて駅から歩けるが、「closed on Mondays this month」なので、月曜日以外に泳ぐ。ノースゲートにはバスがない。月曜日のリバーサイドは休み。

title: Real-Life: Exchanging a camera that arrived damaged
situation: You ordered a camera online, and it arrived with a cracked screen. You need a working camera before your trip next Friday. You hear the following message from the store.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Mail the camera back to Photomax as soon as possible.
Wait at home for a new camera from the warehouse.
Keep the box and accessories until the end of the month.
Take the camera with its box to the Kingsley Road store.
questions.explanation: 今朝のメールの返送の案は「Please ignore that e-mail」と取り消され、すぐに新品を送る案も倉庫に在庫がなく実現しない。最終的な案内は「our Kingsley Road store has one in stock. You can take the damaged camera there and exchange it on the spot」で、「Please bring the box and all the accessories」とも言っている。郵送は約10日かかり金曜日に間に合わない。倉庫から新品は届かない。月末は在庫が戻る時期で、それまで待つのではない。

title: Real-Life: Charging an electric car at a hotel
situation: You are staying at a hotel, and you came by electric car. You want to charge it tonight. You hear the following explanation at the front desk.

questions.question: What should you do first?
choices: Park your car next to the elevator.
Connect your car to a fast charger.
Pay a fee for charging overnight.
Collect a card at reception.
questions.explanation: 充電器を使うには「please pick up a charging card here at the front desk」と言っている。まずフロントでカードを受け取るので、正解はその言い換え。エレベーターのそばの急速充電器は「out of service until tomorrow afternoon」で今夜は使えない。料金は「no extra fee」でかからない。

title: Real-Life: Weekend tennis lessons for a child
situation: Your eight-year-old son wants to take tennis lessons on weekends. You hear the following message from a sports club.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Apply for the Sunday afternoon lessons.
Visit the club on a weekday evening.
Call the club again on Saturday.
Apply online for the Saturday lessons.
questions.explanation: 息子は8歳なので、「Lessons for children aged six to twelve take place on Saturday mornings」の土曜日のレッスンが合う。申し込みは「fill in the form on our website」なので、インターネットで土曜日のレッスンに申し込む。日曜日の午後は10代向け。平日の夜は大人向け。電話で申し込むのではない。

title: Real-Life: Sending a suitcase from a hotel to the airport
situation: You are staying at a hotel. Your flight leaves tomorrow afternoon, and you want to send your suitcase to the airport so you can go sightseeing in the morning. You hear the following information at the front desk.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Complete a form at the desk before midday.
Take your suitcase to the airport tomorrow.
Get a tag from the counter at the airport.
Send your suitcase after lunch today.
questions.explanation: 飛行機は明日の午後なので、「Bags sent by noon today will arrive at the airport by nine tomorrow morning」の正午までに出す必要がある。出すには「Please fill in a delivery form here at the desk」。正午前にフロントで配送票を書くので、正解はその言い換え。自分で空港に運ぶのでは観光できない。札(tag)はホテルが付けるもので、空港でもらうのではない。正午以降に出すと翌日の午後になり間に合わないおそれがある。

title: Real-Life: Parking at a hospital for a long appointment
situation: You are driving your mother to a hospital appointment that will take about three hours. You want to pay as little as possible for parking. You hear the following information.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Park in Lot B and pay for the whole day.
Park in the main lot and pay by the hour.
Park in Lot B and ask the doctor for a stamp.
Park in the main lot and get a pass at reception.
questions.explanation: 予約は約3時間で、「Patients with appointments longer than two hours can get a free pass for the main lot from the reception desk」に当てはまる。第一駐車場に止めて受付で無料券をもらえば、駐車料金はかからない。B駐車場の終日料金や、第一駐車場の時間料金を払う必要はない。医師の印は第一駐車場の無料券に押してもらうもので、B駐車場では使えない。

title: Real-Life: A make-up exam after missing a final
situation: You missed your biology final exam last week because you were sick. You have a note from your doctor. You hear the following message from your university.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: E-mail the note, then go to the seminar room on the 18th.
Hand in the original note, then go to Hall A on the 15th.
Hand in the original note, then go to the seminar room on the 15th.
Hand in the original note, then go to the seminar room on the 18th.
questions.explanation: 生物は理科系の科目なので「Make-up exams for science subjects will now be held on December eighteenth」。場所はAホールが修理中のため「the library seminar room instead」。診断書は「we now need the original paper copy」で、メールでは受け付けなくなった。紙の原本を出し、18日にセミナー室へ行く。15日・Aホールは先のメールの古い情報で、15日はほかの科目の日。

title: Real-Life: A smartphone left on a train
situation: You left your smartphone on a Central Line train yesterday. You want to get it back today. You call the railway and hear the following message.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Go to the last station on the train's route.
Ask a police officer near your home.
Fill out a form on the railway's website.
Wait for the phone to be mailed to you.
questions.explanation: 忘れ物は「first kept for two days at the last station on the train's route」で、「Items found yesterday or today are still at those end stations」と言っている。昨日忘れた電話は路線の終点の駅にあるので、そこへ行く(受け取るときは「please bring a photo ID」)。警察官に聞く、ウェブサイトで用紙に記入する、郵送を待つ、という話はない。

title: Real-Life: Printing a large poster for a presentation
situation: It is Tuesday afternoon. You need a large poster for a presentation at 10 a.m. tomorrow. The file is on your computer and on a USB drive. You call a print shop and hear the following message.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Take the USB drive to the shop before eight p.m.
Print the poster yourself on one of the machines.
Bring the file to the shop early tomorrow morning.
Send the file online and collect the poster this evening.
questions.explanation: 大きなポスターは店員が印刷し、ウェブサイトから送れば「ready in about two hours」。USBメモリで持ち込むと「ready the following afternoon」で、明日の朝10時の発表に間に合わない。今日ウェブで送り、平日は8時まで開いているので今晩受け取る。セルフサービスの機械は「standard documents」用で、ポスターは印刷できない。明日の朝に持ち込んでも間に合わない。

title: Real-Life: Renting bicycles with a young child
situation: You want to rent bicycles on Saturday for yourself and your six-year-old daughter. She cannot ride a bicycle by herself yet. You hear the following at a bicycle rental shop.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Rent a bike with a child seat at the Main Street shop.
Rent a children's bike at the Main Street shop.
Reserve a bike with a child seat at the Harbor branch.
Reserve a tandem attachment at the Harbor branch.
questions.explanation: 子ども用の座席は「up to five years old」なので6歳の娘には使えない。娘はまだ一人で乗れないので子ども用の自転車も合わない。「For older children who can't ride by themselves yet, we recommend our tandem attachment」で、それは「available only at our Harbor branch」。土曜日なので「Reservations are recommended on weekends」に従い、ハーバー店でタンデム用の連結具を予約する。

title: Real-Life: Fever medicine late on a Saturday night
situation: It is 10 p.m. on Saturday. Your young son has a fever, and you want to buy children's fever medicine tonight. You call your local pharmacy and hear the following message.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Wait until the store opens at eight tomorrow.
Go to the Station Road branch within the next hour.
Go to the Station Road branch after midnight.
Call the health line to order the medicine.
questions.explanation: いつもの店は閉まっていて、翌日は日曜日で休業。ステーション通り店は24時間開いているが、子ども用の薬を売るカウンターは「closes at eleven p.m. on weekends」。今は午後10時なので、1時間以内にステーション通り店へ行く。深夜を過ぎるとカウンターは閉まっている。健康相談ダイヤルは「advice from a nurse」で、薬を注文するところではない。

title: Real-Life: A job information session after schedule changes
situation: You want to attend an information session about jobs at Arden Electronics. You work until 5 p.m. on weekdays, and you do not have a car. You hear the following voice message.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Take the free bus to the factory on Thursday.
Register for the online session on Friday at noon.
Go to the headquarters on Thursday evening.
Register for the Friday evening online session.
questions.explanation: 火曜日は「has been canceled」。木曜日は工場に変わり、公共交通機関では行けず、バスは「leaving at four forty-five」だが、あなたは平日5時まで仕事なので乗れない。金曜日の正午は勤務時間中。追加された「a second online session on Friday at seven p.m.」なら参加でき、「Registration is required」なので登録する。木曜日の本社は、会場が変わる前の古い情報。

title: Real-Life: Returning a rental car late at night
situation: You rented a car from City Car Rental. You will return it to the same office at 10 p.m. tonight. You call the office and hear the following message.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Hand the key to a member of staff.
Leave the key on the seat of the car.
Put the key into the box at the entrance.
Drive the car to a different branch.
questions.explanation: 返すのは午後10時で、営業所は「open from seven a.m. to eight p.m.」なので閉まっている。閉店後は「put the key in the drop box by the front door」と言っている。正面入口の横の箱に鍵を入れるので、正解はその言い換え。閉店後なので店員には渡せない。鍵は「do not leave the key inside the car」。返すのは同じ営業所。

title: Real-Life: A library card for a new resident
situation: You have just moved to Greenville, and you want to borrow some books from the library today. You have your passport, but you have not received any mail at your new address yet. You hear the following explanation at the library.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Bring a utility bill to get a full library card.
Ask a parent to request a card for you.
Show your lease to borrow a laptop.
Get a temporary card by showing your passport.
questions.explanation: 正式なカードには住所を証明するものが要るが、あなたは新しい住所でまだ郵便を受け取っていない。「If you don't have proof of address yet, you can get a temporary card with just a photo ID」と言っており、仮のカードでも本は「up to three books」借りられる。パスポート(写真付きの身分証明書)で仮のカードを作るので、正解はその言い換え。光熱費の請求書・賃貸契約書は持っていない。保護者が申し込むのは12歳未満の子ども。

title: Real-Life: Theater seats with a friend in a wheelchair
situation: You want to see a play with your friend, who uses a wheelchair. You want to sit together and pay as little as possible. You call the theater and hear the following message.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Phone a special number to reserve side box seats.
Book two balcony seats through the website.
Reserve two main-floor seats on the website.
Phone a special number to reserve main-floor seats.
questions.explanation: いちばん安いバルコニー席は「can only be reached by stairs」で、車いすの友人は行けない。車いすのスペースは「on the main floor and in the side boxes」にあり、隣に付き添いが座れる。そのうちサイドボックスは「forty-five dollars」で、1階の「sixty dollars」より安い。予約は「call our accessibility line instead of booking online」。専用の番号に電話してサイドボックスの席を取るので、正解はその言い換え。ウェブサイトでは予約できず、1階席は高い。

title: Real-Life: A balloon ride moved because of wind
situation: You are on vacation and want to take a hot-air balloon ride. You can go only on Saturday, and you will not have a car. You are staying near the Grand Hotel. You hear the following recorded message.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Take the shuttle bus from the town center on Saturday.
Go to Hill Park by six on Saturday morning.
Book a place on the Sunday flight instead.
Call by Friday noon to book a ride from the hotel.
questions.explanation: 土曜日の飛行は「has been moved to five p.m. that evening」と夕方に変わった。シャトルバスは「runs only in the morning」なので使えず、代わりにグランドホテルから無料のタクシーが出る。利用するには「call us by noon on Friday to reserve a seat」。車がなく、グランドホテルの近くに泊まっているので、金曜日の正午までに電話してホテルからの送迎を予約する。土曜日の朝6時は変更前の予定。日曜日はあなたが行けない日。

title: Real-Life: Visiting a friend in the hospital on a weekend
situation: Your friend is staying in Ward B of Central Hospital. You want to visit her on Saturday afternoon. You call the hospital and hear the following message.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Visit her at eleven a.m. on Saturday.
Bring some flowers to her room.
Visit her after six p.m. on Saturday.
Register at the second-floor desk before seeing her.
questions.explanation: B病棟の面会は「must first sign in at the reception desk on the second floor」と言っている。2階の受付で記帳してから会うので、正解はその言い換え。週末のB病棟の面会は「from two p.m. to five p.m. only」なので、午前11時や午後6時以降には会えない(午前10時からはほかの病棟の面会時間)。花は「not allowed in any patient rooms」。

title: Real-Life: Finding cookbooks in a large bookstore
situation: You are at a large bookstore. You want to buy a cookbook. You hear the following announcement.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Go to the third floor.
Go to the fourth floor.
Go to the shop next door.
Come back to the store tomorrow.
questions.explanation: 「Cookbooks and travel books are on the third floor」と言っている。料理の本は3階なので、正解は本文と同じ語。4階、隣の店、明日また来る、という話はない。

title: Real-Life: A flat bicycle tire before work
situation: Your bicycle has a flat tire. You need to ride it to work tomorrow morning. It is now five p.m. on Wednesday. You call a bike shop and hear the following message.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Leave the bike in the overnight drop-off area.
Take the bike to the shop this evening and wait.
Bring the bike to the shop at ten tomorrow.
Ask the shop to change the bike's chain.
questions.explanation: 今は水曜日の午後5時で、店は「ten a.m. to seven p.m.」に開いている。パンクは「can usually be fixed while you wait, in about twenty minutes」なので、今晩持っていけば待つ間に直る。夜間の預かり場所に置くと「we'll repair it the next day」で、明日の朝に乗れない。明日の10時では出勤に間に合わない。チェーンの交換は必要ない。

title: Real-Life: Sending a heavy present to Australia
situation: You want to send a birthday present to a friend in Australia. It needs to arrive within one week. The package weighs three kilograms. You call the post office and hear the following message.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Send the package by Express Air.
Send the package by Standard Air.
Use Economy Mail to save money.
Arrange a delivery with a partner company at a counter.
questions.explanation: 1週間以内に届くのはエクスプレス航空便(「within five days」)だけだが、「can only be used for packages under two kilograms」で、3キロの小包には使えない。「For heavier packages that need to arrive quickly, please use our partner courier service, which can be booked at any of our counters」と言っているので、窓口で提携の宅配便を申し込む。スタンダード航空便は「ten days to two weeks」、エコノミー郵便は「three to four weeks」で間に合わない。

title: Real-Life: A beach cleanup moved to another beach
situation: You want to join a beach cleanup as a volunteer. You can only take part on Sunday morning, and you will come by train. You hear the following message.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Go to North Beach early on Sunday morning.
Buy gloves and bags before Sunday.
Join the cleanup at North Beach on Saturday.
E-mail the office to ask for a ride to the beach.
questions.explanation: 日曜日の清掃は「has been moved to South Beach」で、サウス・ビーチは「far from the train station, and no buses go there on Sunday mornings」。電車で行くので、駅からのワゴン車を使うことになり、「Please e-mail us by Friday if you plan to use it」と言っている。ノース・ビーチは日曜日の変更前の場所。手袋と袋は寄付があり「you don't need to bring anything」。土曜日はあなたが参加できない日。

title: Real-Life: Returning library DVDs during a holiday closure
situation: You borrowed two DVDs from the city library. They are due on Sunday, but you will be away on a trip until Monday night. You hear the following message when you call the library.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Take the DVDs to the library on Tuesday.
Put the DVDs in the outdoor return box.
Pay a late fee when you get back.
Return the DVDs on Saturday morning.
questions.explanation: 休館中に期限が来る資料は「can be returned on Tuesday without a late fee」で、DVDは「cannot be put in the outdoor return box」。あなたは月曜日の夜まで旅行中なので、火曜日に図書館に持っていけばよい。返却ボックスに入れてよいのは本だけ。火曜日に返せば延滞料はかからない。土曜日は休館で、あなたも旅行中。

title: Real-Life: A guided tour at a science center with a young child
situation: You are planning to visit a science center with your six-year-old son on Saturday afternoon. You want to join a guided tour. You hear the following message when you call the center.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Book the space tour for the afternoon.
Sign up for the three o'clock robot tour.
Reserve the dinosaur tour on the Internet.
Buy tour tickets at the center on Saturday.
questions.explanation: 午後に行けて6歳の子が参加できるのは「The dinosaur tour starts at one and is open to children of all ages」。ツアーは「must be booked online in advance」なので、恐竜のツアーをインターネットで予約する。宇宙のツアーは午前で、10歳以上が対象。ロボットのツアーは今週の土曜日は満員。当日に科学館で買うのではなく、事前の予約が必要。

title: Real-Life: Arriving at a hotel after the front desk closes
situation: You have booked a room at a hotel for tonight, but your train will get you to the hotel at about 1 a.m. You do not want to pay any extra charges. You hear the following message from the hotel.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Settle the bill on the Internet this afternoon.
Ask the night staff to let you in.
Get to the hotel before midnight.
Phone the front desk for the key box code.
questions.explanation: あなたは午前1時に着くので、フロントは閉まっている。夜間の係員に入れてもらうと「a late check-in fee of twenty dollars」がかかる。キーボックスの番号は「we can only send to guests who have paid for their room online in advance」なので、追加料金を払わずに入るには「please use the link ... by 6 p.m.」で、今日の午後のうちにインターネットで支払う。午前0時前には着けない。番号は電話で聞くのではなく、事前に払った人に送られる。

title: Real-Life: A parents' meeting moved for a staff training session
situation: Your daughter is in the third grade. You want to attend the parents' meeting about the school trip, but you work until 5 p.m. on weekdays. You hear the following message from the school.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Go to the school on Wednesday afternoon.
Watch the recording before handing in the form.
Attend the meeting on Tuesday at 4 p.m.
Attend the meeting on Thursday evening.
questions.explanation: 3年生の保護者会は水曜日の午後4時から「has been moved to Thursday at 6 p.m.」に変わった。あなたは平日5時まで働いているので、午後6時からなら出席できる。水曜日は変更前の日で、4時は仕事中。録画は「only be available from next Monday」で、用紙は今週の金曜日が期限なので、提出の前には見られない。火曜日は1・2年生の会。

title: Real-Life: Picking up a suit before a weekend wedding
situation: Today is Wednesday. You need your suit from the dry cleaner for a wedding on Saturday. You can only go to the shop after work, at 7 p.m. You hear the following message when you call the shop.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Go to the shop on Wednesday evening.
Ask the shop to deliver your suit.
Visit the shop on Saturday morning.
Pick up your suit on Friday evening.
questions.explanation: 今日は水曜日で、あなたが店に行けるのは午後7時以降。水曜日と木曜日は「close early, at 6 p.m.」で間に合わない。「On Friday, we will be open until 8 p.m. as usual」なので、金曜日の夜に取りに行けばよい。配達の話はない。「We are closed on weekends」なので土曜日は休み。

title: Real-Life: Volunteering at a city marathon with a knee injury
situation: You want to volunteer at the city marathon next month. You are free only on the day of the race. Because of a knee injury, you cannot stand for a long time. You hear the following message.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Apply to help with checking in runners.
Apply to work at a water station.
Join the team that cheers along the course.
Go to the convention center two days before.
questions.explanation: あなたは大会当日しか空いておらず、膝のけがで長く立っていられない。受付チームは「works indoors ... checking in runners while seated at desks」で、「on the morning of the race」にも活動し「you can choose which days to work」とあるので、当日だけ座って働ける。給水所は「must be able to stand for long periods」、コースは約5時間立って応援するので合わない。大会の2日前は空いていない。

title: Real-Life: Renting a community center room with a projector
situation: Today is Monday. You want to rent a room at the community center for a meeting of 15 people next Sunday afternoon. You will need a projector. You hear the following message.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Book Room A for Sunday afternoon.
Book Room C and invite fewer people.
Book Room A and bring your own projector.
Book Room B and reserve a projector.
questions.explanation: A室は「used by a dance class every Sunday afternoon」で日曜日の午後は使えない。C室は「holds up to ten people」で15人は入れない。B室は30人まで入れて週末も空いており、プロジェクターは「if you reserve it at least three days in advance」借りられる。今日は月曜日なので間に合う。人数を減らすことはできないので、B室とプロジェクターを予約する。

title: Real-Life: Swimming at a sports center after a repair delay
situation: You have a membership at the city sports center. You want to go swimming this Saturday. You hear the following recorded message when you call the center.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Swim in the main pool on Saturday morning.
Join the free open day on Saturday.
Wait until the pool reopens next Wednesday.
Swim in the training pool after 11 a.m.
questions.explanation: メインプールの土曜日の再開は「will now reopen next Wednesday」に変わった。練習用プールは土曜日に開くが「reserved for children's lessons until 11 a.m., and members are welcome to use it after that」なので、会員のあなたは11時以降に泳げる。土曜日の朝のメインプールは修理の遅れで使えない。無料開放日は「has been canceled」で、もともと会員でない人向け。土曜日に泳ぎたいので、水曜日まで待つ必要はない。

title: Real-Life: A lost apartment key on a workday
situation: Today is Thursday. You lost your apartment key this morning, and you have to work until 6 p.m. today. You need to get into your apartment tonight. You call the building's management company and hear the following message.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Ask a neighbor to keep your spare key.
Call the 24-hour key service.
Stay at a hotel near your workplace.
Go to the police station after work.
questions.explanation: 事務所は平日の「9 a.m. to 5 p.m.」で、あなたは今日午後6時まで仕事なので行けない。「If you cannot come during office hours, please call our 24-hour key service」とあるので、24時間の鍵サービスに電話すればよい。正解は本文と同じ言葉。近所の人に合鍵を預ける、ホテルに泊まる、警察に行く、という話はない。

title: Real-Life: A river cruise with a small dog
situation: You want to take a river cruise this afternoon with your small dog. You have a pet carrier with you. You hear the following announcement at the ticket office.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Take the garden cruise from the east pier.
Board the city cruise at the main pier.
Book a seat on the sunset dinner cruise.
Leave your dog at the ticket office.
questions.explanation: 庭園クルーズは「Small pets are welcome ... as long as they stay in a carrier」で、午後2時と4時に出発する。あなたはキャリーを持っているので、今日の午後に乗れる。市内クルーズは「pets are not allowed」。ディナークルーズは食事のスペースにペットが入れない。乗船券売り場に犬を預ける話はない。

title: Real-Life: Delivery of a refrigerator to a fifth-floor apartment
situation: You bought a refrigerator online. You live on the fifth floor of a building with no elevator. You work from home only on Tuesdays and Thursdays. You hear the following message from the store.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Choose free delivery on a Thursday.
Choose standard delivery on a Friday.
Choose two-person delivery on a Monday.
Choose two-person delivery on a Tuesday.
questions.explanation: あなたはエレベーターのない5階に住んでいるので、通常の配達は「only bring large items to the first floor」で使えず、2人での配達が必要。それは「available on Mondays and Tuesdays only」。あなたが家にいるのは火曜日と木曜日なので、両方に当てはまる火曜日を選ぶ。木曜日は配達がない。金曜日の通常の配達では1階までしか運ばない。月曜日は家にいない。

title: Real-Life: Getting rid of newspapers and a chair in a holiday week
situation: Today is Monday. You want to get rid of some old newspapers and a broken chair this week. You are leaving on a trip early on Friday morning and will be away for a week. You hear the following message from the city.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Put out the paper and the chair together on Wednesday.
Put out the paper on Thursday and book a pickup for the chair.
Book a Saturday pickup for both the paper and the chair.
Put out the paper on Wednesday and take the chair in yourself.
questions.explanation: 紙は木曜日が祝日のため「collected on Wednesday instead of Thursday」。粗大ごみも水曜日の予定だったが「this has been changed」で土曜日の午前になった。あなたは金曜日の朝から旅行に出るので、土曜日の収集は使えない。粗大ごみは「bring large items directly to the city recycling center」こともでき、センターは日曜日以外開いている。紙は水曜日に出し、椅子はセンターに持ち込む。水曜日に椅子を出すのは取り消された予定。

title: Real-Life: Seeing a doctor on a Saturday with a fever
situation: You have a fever and want to see a doctor this Saturday morning. You will drive to the clinic. You hear the following message when you call.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Make an appointment for Saturday morning.
Wait for the doctor in the waiting room.
Go to the clinic on Saturday afternoon.
Phone the clinic from your car when you get there.
questions.explanation: 熱のある人は「please stay in your car and call us when you arrive」と言っている。着いたら車から電話すればよいので、正解はその言い換え。土曜日は「we do not take appointments」。熱があるので待合室には入らない。土曜日は正午までなので、午後は開いていない。

title: Real-Life: Leaving a large suitcase at a station
situation: You want to leave a large suitcase at the station for a few hours. You hear the following announcement.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Use a coin locker near the east exit.
Find a small locker near the west exit.
Come back to the station after 8 p.m.
Leave your suitcase with staff by the ticket office.
questions.explanation: 大きなスーツケースは「please take it to the baggage counter next to the ticket office」と案内されている。切符売り場の隣で係員に預けるので、正解はその言い換え。東口のロッカーは「all full」。西口のロッカーは幅50センチまでで、大きなスーツケースは入らない。カウンターは午後8時までなので、それより後に来ても預けられない。

title: Real-Life: A free yoga class for a beginner
situation: You have never done yoga before. You want to join a free yoga class at the community center this Saturday. You do not have a yoga mat. You hear the following message when you call the center.

questions.question: What should you do first?
choices: Register on the website for the 9 a.m. class before Friday.
Register on the website for the 2 p.m. class before Friday.
Borrow a mat from the center when you arrive on Saturday.
Sign up for the class at the front desk on Saturday.
questions.explanation: あなたはヨガが初めてなので、「The morning class at nine is for beginners」の午前の教室が合う。申し込みは「sign up online by Thursday」なので、金曜日より前にウェブサイトで申し込む。午後2時は「for experienced members」。マットは今月「all of our mats are being replaced」で借りられない。受付で売っているのはマットで、申し込みはインターネットで行う。

title: Real-Life: An elephant feeding with a child in a stroller
situation: You are at the main gate of a zoo with your four-year-old son, who is in a stroller. You want to see the elephant feeding. You hear the following announcement.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Push your son in the stroller along the path.
Take your son onto the train in his stroller.
Wait until the path opens and then walk there.
Drop off the stroller, then go there by rail.
questions.explanation: アフリカ・エリアへの道は「closed for repairs this morning」で、11時のえさやりに行くには「the train is the only way to get there before noon」。ただし「strollers are not allowed on the zoo train」なので、「you can leave them at the train station」のとおり駅にベビーカーを置いて列車に乗る。道は今朝は通れない。ベビーカーのまま列車には乗れない。道が開くのを待つと、えさやりに間に合わない。

title: Real-Life: A gate change before a flight home
situation: You are in Terminal A of the airport. You are taking Flight JA225 to Tokyo, but you have not checked in yet. You hear the following announcement.

questions.question: What should you do first?
choices: Take the airport train to Terminal B.
Go straight to Gate 30 to board the plane.
Wait for the free bus to Terminal B.
Get a new boarding pass at a counter in Terminal A.
questions.explanation: あなたはまだ搭乗手続きをしていない。そういう人は「should first go to the transfer counter on the first floor of this terminal」と案内されている。今いるターミナルAのカウンターで新しい搭乗券を受け取るので、正解はその言い換え。列車でターミナルBへ行くのは新しい搭乗券を受け取った後。30番ゲートへ直接行くのは「already checked in」の人。無料のシャトルバスは「not running at this time」と取り消された。

title: Real-Life: A train to the art museum
situation: You are at Central Station. You want to go to the City Art Museum by train. You hear the following announcement.

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Take a bus from the front of the station.
Take the Green Line from Platform 3.
Ask for a map at the ticket office.
Buy a special ticket for the museum.
questions.explanation: 美術館へ行く人は「please take the Green Line from Platform 3」と案内されている。正解はその内容。バス、切符売り場の地図、美術館の特別な切符の話はない。
